8bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥces gsog ba btab pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog nas brtse bas rjes su bzung ste thon mi nang chos dang sgra rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa mthar son thub pa byung / nam zhig rang gi mkhyen sku na rgyas te rgyal 'o( chen po'i thugs 'dun slong thub pa dang / bod rgyal khab la phan thogs nges can gyi sri zhu sgrub thub pa'i gdeng ngam sgobs pa zhig rnyed pa na bod du log na don che bar dgongs te kha ba can gyi yul du phyir phebs gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa 'khrungs so/ /gang gi mkhyen pa'i chu tshad dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma snang ga gis rjes su bzung ba'i dan rtags ni mkhas dga' las/nyamakhas pa li byin dgyes pas lan gsungs pa/ /bden nyid ro snan rtog slon chen rig pa can/ khyod la yi ge sgra dang snyan ngag sogs//5wan tan ngo mtshar can kun slo rwa ba lnga zhes/ /yi ge'i rigs rnams kun ga ma sna ngas bstan/ /rig pa'i rtsal phye shes rab spro na me bteg/rnam mang du ma'i yi ge kho snang du chud/ /lha rig seng ge la ro gas paṇ+ḍi ta//mkhas pa gzhan yang bsten nas sgra tshad dang / /rig pa'i gnas mang khong du chud par byas/ /theg pa chen po'i gsung rab mang du sbyangs//17da du 'dre don tshe mkhan spro li byin gyis/ spu da ni rig gnas kun la rtse mor son/ /da ni sprul pa'i rgyal po'i dgongs pa sgrubs/ /bod yul 'phra kun yi ge sgra tshad dang / /lung rigs man ngag rnams kyis tshim par mdzod//5
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 9ces bram ze chen po li byin gyis lnga na mi rang nyid rig gnas mang lpa dor mkhas par gyur pa dang / bod du byon nas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs 'grub phyir sgra tshad sogs kyi slob gnyer bod yul kun tu tshim par mdzod cig ces bka'i gnang ba spyi bor stsal ba na thon mi nyid kyis slob dpon la gtang rag gi tshul du zhus pa 'di lta ste/thon mis yon phul gtang rag tshig brjod pa/ /thugs la btags ro rgyal ba'i sras/ /bka' drin che kho sngo mtshar che/ /byin gyis gu bas shig thugs rje can/ /rig pa dri med kyi nam mkha' la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar/ /slon lam dag pa'i rlung gis drangs/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i nyi zla shar/ /'do ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gsal yid kyi rgya mdo rdo la /rig pa blo yi chu phran 'khor/ /slon lam dag pa'i chu bya lding / /sgra tshad yi ge'i nor bu bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel bar byed// casgyu lus dri med kyi 〈snang 〈sna la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi yal ga rgyas//bslabs shes sku don tan gyi me to snag shar/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i 'bras bu smin//bdag ro snad kyi 〈snan 'o/ 1snan mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags//rgya gar yul du phyin pa yin/ /mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin//〈snan tan gzhi ma yi ge yin/ /ma lus 〈snang du chud pa yin/ /lnga da yul dbus su 'gro ba yin/ /rgyal pos dga' storwa na mdzad pa yin//rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin/ /rgyal spros dbu mdzad slon po la//sgra tshad yi ge spel ba yin/ /kun la rgyas par byed pa yin/ /thugs la btags 1r+sha rgyal ba'i sras//6
10bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥzhes zhus so/ /rgyal po chen pos thon mi saṃ sto ṭa bod kha ba can gyi yul du byon pa'i gtam bzang gsan pa na thugs dgyes mir chen 'od byung / gang gi bka' bsgo sa bzhin bsu ba dga' lta na bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ rgyal 5wa dga' sto snan gyi gdan sar byon pa la blon po thon mis na ro/ gi gu /zhabs kyu/ sogs sde tshan du byas te yi ge'i phud phul ba 'di lta ste/zhal ras gsal la rang mdangs gang ba bzang / /gdams ngag zab la ma chad tha dad rang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa//'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa lags/ /bde gshegs bden nges yī shes te/ /ting 'dzin zhi nyid rig cing gzigs/ /nyon mongs don gas ba༄wam ma spro na 'od mchog /dus gsum bdud 'dul kun tu thul//spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi sras/ /srong btsan sgam 〈snar mtshan ga〈snal ba'i/ /mār+shas rgyal khyed la phyag 'tshal 'ong 7zhes gsungs pa ltar yig phud rang nas bod kyi skad yig tu legs sbyar gyi me long ma ma bsgyur 〈snang nas bya dka'i sgra rgyan gyi 〈snal 5wad pa shes thub/ 〈snas rgyal nyid kyis thon mi nyid bod kha ba can pa rnams la bka' drin rmad du byung ba yin par mkhyen te snyu na mir slon 'od gzhan rnams las gtsigs mthong che bar mdzad/phrag dog can gyi slon po 'ga' zhig gis rgyal 5was thon mir bkur gzos ches cher mdzad par ma bzod de rgyal por de ltar mi mdzad par zhu zhes gsol ba na tshogs kyi dbus su slon po chen spro thon mis nga rgyal gyi smru blangs pa 'di ltar/
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 11nga drin can gyi slon po thon mi ngas/ /lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du/ /lus tsha grang che yang dka' ba spyad/ lta dang mkhas pa bram ze li byin la/ /yid gus pa'i tshul gyis snangs gus byas/ /sbya r+shar rin chen gser gyi phyag rten phul/ /don rnyed par dka' ba'i yig 'bru bstan//slo the tshom sel ba'i mdzub khrid byas/ /tshig dbyangs yig rnams la mkhas par sbyangs/ /rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa de/ /ro snad yig sum cur dru gtan la phab/ /rang mkhas pa'i nges shes 〈sna la shar/ /'phral sku rwan tan thams cad kho nga du chud/ /dus da lta dga' la phyi ma skyid/ /yul mtha' 'khogi ba bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi mkhas pa sleb pa'i 〈snan ma yin//nga mun pa sel ba'i lha na me yin/ /rje rgyal spro nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs//grogs slon po'i khrod na nga tsam med/ /bod kha ba can pa'i mi rnams la//nga 〈snan mi bka' drin mi che 'am rda zhes 〈snags smras pa na da ga sbra rwad blon po gzhan rnams kyi phrag dog gi rba rlabs rang zhir gyur/ 1—na mis 〉skyod kyi skad yig la mkho sna ba'i yi ge gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pa na legs sbyar gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug bod yig gi dbyangs lngar bsdus par mdzad/ de yang nyang chos 'byung las/dbyangs yig bcu drug na ro gu gu'i khongs su bsdus te bsgyur ro//i gu gur bsgyur/ u zhabs kyur bsgyur/ e 'greng bur/ 'o sna na 〈sna/a rtseg tu bsgyur te//9
12bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥzhes dang / de bzhin lnga snad kyi skad la mkho ba'i yi ge legs sbyar gyi skad yig tu'ang yod pa rnams zur bton mdzad de bod yig gsal byed sum cu las gsal byed nyer bzhi yig gzugs dang bcas pa gtan la phab/ lhag ma gsal byed drug po bod skad la mkho yang legs sbyar la med pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas re zhig yid khong du chud par gyur te mnag du song ba las sad pa'i dus su skyes bu rgan po phyag 'khar thogs pa zhig dang 'phrad de yi ge drug po rnyed pa'i rkyen du gyur/de yang / nyang chos 'byung gas/'o/da yig nyi shu rtsa bzhi las ma rnyed nas smra ba bsdebs su ma 'do stod nas skad ma khugs te kho nga dbu 'a ro mas te nyal nas 'dug pa mnal du 5wang theb dang mnal sad pa'i tshe rang gi rtsan skyes bu rgan po phyag 'khar thogs pa zhig 'dug nas snyu sted gang nas sku ngas/ gar 'bo / ci byed pa yin/rigs gang yin/ nga'i lha sna bsdams pa la gang nas thar zhes smras pas/rgyad po na re/ chos nyid gshis la gong 'og med/ /yang dag don la bya byed med/ /nam mkha' lam du byas pa la/ /〈sna cha bsdams pas ga la thub/ /zer 1ri/ /de 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin par rig nas yang yang du dris pas rgyad po na re/ nga zhang zhung mi yul nas 'ongs/za hor gyi yul du 'gro zer/ thag ji tsam yod byas pas ci cha zer/'chog rgyags ci 54da byas pas ja 5wad zer/ rigs ni 'a zha'i yin zer/mi snang bar song ngo 10〈snang gi rkyen de dag la thodzin mis dpyad pa na/ rigs 'a zha yin zer ba las 'a yig rnyed/ zhang zhung nas 'ong zer ba las zha yig rnyed/ za hor yul du 'gro zer ba
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 13gas za yig rnyed/ thag ji tsam byas pas ci cha zer ba las ca yig dang cha yig rnyed/ 'tsho rgyags ja yod byas pa las ja yig rnyed do/ /des na rgya gar na med pa'i yi ge drug spro rna bsnan te bod yig tu gsal byed sum cu tham par bzos pa dang /dbyangs la mtshon na'ang rgya gar gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug gi bya ba de bod skad du dbyangs lnga yis byed pa yin/ des na bod yig tu dbyangs lnga dang gsal byed sum cur gtan la phab bo/ /gong du bshad pa 'di ni yi ge drug wa 3 dag rnyed pa'i rkyen tsam bshad pa gas dgos pa gsungs med na de dag bzo dgos pa'i dgos pa'ang lo rgyus de nyid du gsungs yod/ ji skad du/bed da kyi gcig la rgya gar e ka zhes te 'o/da la ma btub nas ca bcug/rgya'i lo ka bod kyi 'jig rten ma btub pas ja bcug /rgya'i dharma la bod kyi phyur+shas bya ba ma btub nas cha bcug/ rgya'i bri ta la 'od da kyi zhu ba bya ba byung bas zha bcug /bod kyi yi ge ring 'od med pas 'a bcug/11 9ces pa las yi ge lnga yi da lha rwa so pa ma gdog gas gsungs med pa la bltas na chad pa'i lha sten du snang / de'i kha 〈snang lta bur kha rgyan las lung 'dren byas na yi ge drug 'o( thams cad kyi da〈snas pa tshang bar 'gyur/ de yang kha rgyan las/yi ge de dag bcug das rwas pa'i da spro sgos pa ni/ rgya skad du e ka zhes pa lnga da skad du gcig gi ming dang / rgya skad du dharma zhes pa ro snad skad du 〈snas kyi ming dang / rgya skad du 'o rna ka zhes pa 〈snad skad du 'jig rten gyi ming yin pas ca cha ja gsum rgya skad la med kyang bod da skad la de bzhin mkho ba dang / rgya skad du da dhi zhes pa bod skad du zho'i ming dang /
14bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥrgya gar skad du bhak+ṣa ma zhes pa bod skad du zas kyi ming dang / rgya skad du du ka dha zhes pa lnga da skad du ca / ma'i ming yin pas zha za 'a gsum yang bod skad la nye bar mkho ba'i dgos dbang gis rgya gar na med pa'i yi gi drug gsar du ston dgos pa byung ngo //12zhes pa las ca cha ja dang / zha za 'a ste yi ge drug 'od gsar du bsnan pa'i rkyen dang da spro sa pa gang yin sngar gyi 'o/ rgyus su gsal ba rnams las rang res da ya sna ka thub/de ltar thon mis bod kyi skad la dgos mkho'i dbang gis legs sbyar gyi dbyangs gsal la 'phri sne don mdzad de lnga da yig tu dbyangs gsal sum cu rtsa bzhi gtan la phrab/ legs sbyar gyi sngags yig rnams lnga da skad du tshul bzhin 'de don pa la gha la 〈/ kas pa'i mthug po'i yi ge dang / ṭa la ro/gas pa'i 'o/ga pa'i yi ge rnams yi ge'i rnam da phru da la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis rting du ba༄was par grags dra //de yang rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me 'odang gi mchan bur/na 'odaka (ṇa )dang / sha spo rwa ka( khu) /tha 'o rwa ka (ṭha)byed pa do/gas ni so skṛ ta'i skad/ ro da du gzungs sngags su 'gyur dus/ yi ge'i rnam da cakha da la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis rting du ba〈snas ro 13zhes de ltar lnga na mi'i bka' drin nyag cig la brten nas be snad kha ba can du shes rig gi sa 'o/na legs par thebs te rje 'bangs kun yi ge'i 1snas bsam la zhugs pa dang / yi ge'i byed spro thon mi sam bh+yo ṭa yin pa ni lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'kho da pa spro nga du drangs zin cing /rim gyis ston pa bka' drin can gyi gsung rab rnams bod skad du bsgyur ba'i lo
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 15tsā ba zam ma chad par byung ba rnams kyi dbus su 'od tsā ba la snga ba ni lnga na mi sam bh+yo ṭa yin pa nyang chos 'byung du gsal zhing de bzhin 'dir smras chos 'byung dang /mkhas pa lde'u sa mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa rnam gnyis su thorwa na mis chos bsgyur ba la snga ba ni mdo sde pad ma dkar po dang / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/ gzungs tsin+ta ma ṇi/ tog dang gra lnga rnams yin pa 'khod yod do//smra sgo'i lde mig tu/lnga da yig gi byung ba'i lnga ga la bar skabs shig nas gsung smra la la rgya gar gyi yi ge la ca cha ja dang / zha za 'a drug med pa lnga na mis bod yig la gsar du bsnan dgos par byung bar grags sdud da/de ni zha lu lo sto bas thog mar gsungs pa phyis kyi brda sprod pa rnams kyis yang nas yang du torwa so pas/ de lta na'ang rgya gar gyi skad la ca cha ja gsum med pa ma lnga na sum la ba lha na pa'i gtam yin tshul mkhas 9dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs pa ltar don la gnas pa ni rgya gar gyi skad la bltas pa tsam gyis ltarwa kas nus//14zhes lung 'dren gnang 'dug kyang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung 'di nyid la dpyad pa zhig byas na/ kho nga gis gsungs pa de yis zha lu'i gsung la 〉ri lnga gas pa'i dgag pa zhig tu gyur med/ da lta'i char nga tshor thon mi'i lo rgyus nges pa 'drongs pa zhig rnyed du med na thon mi rgya gar gyi yul gang zhig tu phebs yod pa de bas kyang shes par dka'/ gus pa'i bsam tshul ltar byas na lnga na mi gang du phebs pa'i rgya gar gyi yul gru de ni rgya gar gyi yul ga ge ro/ gang du ca la tsa yi sgra
16bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥgdangs su thon pa de 'dra zhig tu thon mi phebs yod par sems/ der brtendge chor+shas rgyu mtshan du byas te zha lu'i gsung ror+sha na la mi gnas pa zhu mi sprad baslhag par bka' chems ka khol mar yang ji skad du/rgya gar skad du e kā/ bod skad du gcig zer du ma btub nas bod yig la byu bcug /dharma la chor+shas bya ba bsgyur ma btub ste nā bcug/'o/ ga'i sgra la 'jig rten ma btub ste ju bcug /nam la zhe sa ma btub nas zhu bcug /bod yig la ring thung ma btub nas 'u bcug ste bod yig rgya la med pa phyed dang drug yod do sgra sor bzhag ste bod yig tu : sgra sku ra bzhag pa ni 'o/da yig gi sngags yin pā //15zhes ches gsal bar 'khod 'dug na zha lu lo tsā bas thog mar gsungs pa min pa lung 'dis grub bo/ /der ma zad ma ṇi bka' 'bum du ca cha ja gsum/ zha za 'a gsum bsnan pa yang gsung 'dug go/163yig gzugs la 'gyur 'gros byung tshul/lha rgya gar na grags che ba'i yig rigs gsum zhi lañdza lha'i yi ge /na ga ra klu'i yi ge /bha gru ma mi'i yi ge bcas yin la/ lnga na mis na ga ra la dpe blangs te dbu can dang / bha gru ma la dpe byas nas dbu med brtsams pa nyang chos 'byung du gsal/lha shun kyang deng rabs kyi yi ge'i gzugs la nyams zhib pa khag cig gis lañdza'i yi ge zhes pa'i yi ge'i gzugs shig lo rgyus kyi khrod du rtsab nas rnyed kyi med skor gsung bzhin yod/ lañdza lha'i yi ge zhes pa 'di phal cher ra nyid la yi sgra gdangs
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 17su 'gyur te rañdza la lañdza ra smras pa yin shas che/ ci ste de nyid ra khu'i yi ge yin pa'i dbang du btang na ni dus kyi 〈 sna nas 1khud yig gi phyi lha/ sgrub thabs gtan nas med de 1 rañdza'i yi ge brgya phrag bdun pa'i sngon la med pa'i phyir/ lar nas gna' ro'i sgrar ra nyid lar 'gyur ba du ma mchis te gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma las/rgya gar gyi rdo ring rnying ma 'ga' la yang / rā dza bya ba'i tshab tu lā dza/ra hul bya ba la la hul bya bar bris/ rañdza na bya ba'i yi ge de la yang rang res lañtsa zhes 'a lha skyod//17ces gsal/ la ( 'e yi ge la dpe byas nas dbu can byung tshul gyi bshad pa de ma ṇi bka' 'bum du gsal 'dug kyang / 'o/ rgyus kyi cha nas khas len du mi rung snyam/ma ṇi bka' 'bum ni grub thob da lnga sa grub dang nyang re nyi ma 'od rnam gnyis kyis rim bzhin glegs bam sto snad smad gnyis ra sa 'khrul snang gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtse'i byang ngos rta mgrin zhabs co snyon nas snga phyir gsar nas bzhes shing kho nga rnam gnyis ni phyi lo brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi 'go stod du byon zhing der brten rtsa ba'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum 11nga btsan gyi zhal chems bkrus nas ma dag pa zhig nges par du yid rton 'pher ba yin rung / dus kyi 'gyur 'gros dang / lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim/de bzhin dgag dgos kyi dbang gis 'phri ston sogs byung ba yang bsnyon du med pa'i gtam zhig yin/ dper na/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum du/ 'phags pa za ma torwa ka bto da pa theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi yi bdag nyid can rangs 'od de gar bzhugs pa lta bu yin/ mdo smad pa dge 'dun chos 'phel ltar na bod yig gi phyi slo zhi gup+ta'i yi ge yin snyam gsungs sku/da/ deb dkar gas/
18bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥgang ltar yang thu mi de rgya gar na gup+ta'i rgyal rgyud dag gis srid skyodang ba'i skabs su wu na pa yin zhing / shin tu lnga ri mtshar ba ni thu mi dang dus mnyam pa'i rgya gar gyi rgyal po ha r+ṣa dang / ku mā ra gup+ta/4 6warma na 5wags kyi dus su byung ba'i zangs kyi glegs bu la smra/gas pa da lta'i bar rgya gar gyi yul sku sor sku da pa dag la yi ge bto da pa rnams 'o/da yig dang ha cang 'dra che zhing / cung zad rgyang nas bltas tshe lag mi mkhas pa zhig gis lnga rwad yig bris sam snyam pa 'char/ yig 'bru phal cher ma bslab kyang lnga dor re ba zhig klorwa ka thub par 'dug/18nya ces gsungs yod/ bu stodon ltar na gzugs kha che'i yi ge dang bstun nas lha sa'i sku mkhar ma rur bcos zhes dang / 7rgyal dbang lnga pa ltar na/ lañdza la dpe byas te dbu can dang wartu la dpe byas te dbu med brtsams zhes snang /gang ltar dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i gong du bod na dpar shing ma dar bas yig gzugs gcig tu 'gyur med ngang gnas thabs med par brten yig gzugs la rim gyis 'gyur ba byung yod//lnga ga mar lnga snan mi nyid kyis phyag bris gnang ba de la sbal nag na la bgrad 'dra ze ra/ yi ge 'di yi dpe gcig lha sa'i brag lo snags su btab 〈 snad/ces nyang chor+shas 'byung du gsal/ lnga na mis bya dka'i lam nas drangs pa'i rgyal por phul ba'i bstodod bsngags de nyid yig gzugs 'di thog bris pa yin ga/'di nyid da lta lha sa'i shar rgyud dzen khog sna rdo'i lha khang (da lta mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs btsun mo tshal dgon pa )gi brag la ba〉stos nas 5 rwa da 'o sto/ /zhes rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long du gsal//

36bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥstod dgra 'dul dbang po dang tur nā thas mdzad pa'i rgya gar chos 'byung du bshad pa'i sgra'i 'o/ rgyus dang 'gal 'o///ga lā pa de nyid bod du thog mar lo tsā ba sus bsgyur thad slo bzang slo gros zhu ba nas/ ched rtsom ring po de nang shong ston gyis bsgyur ba ches gsal bor bkod 'dug /de yang de nyid gas/de nas 'a spro ba'i ma to na 'o/ khu)sa rgyal 'phags pa dang da'o don chen shākya cibzang po'i (srid 'od 124441275)bka' lung gis bskul nas mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sku stong 〈khun dod rje rgyal mtshan bal yul du 47na nas ṇ+ḍa ṇ+ḍi ta ma he bha ste sa bzang dbang po 'o/ lnga bsten nas rig gnas chung ba lngar bslabs shing / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣa mi ka ra sku/gas bsten nas sgra rig pa la shin tu byang bar mdzad de/ sgra snyan sogs sngar ma bsgyur ba'i 'gyur mang du mdzad cing / khyad par du kya lā pa dang tsan+d+ra pa'i gzhung ro snad skad du bsgyur cing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste kun gyis stso rwab tu rung bar mdzad//27ces byung / 'on kyang 'dar stod kyis/shong gi thugs la skyes stobs kyi slo gros ni phun sum tshogs/ sbyor byung gi nan tan mchor+sha ga tu gyur na legs bshad gsar pa bsgyur ba cis mi nus snyam du da to/ngas te 'phags pa'i gzims ga5rdzog pa mdod smad pa slo gros rgyal po dang 'grogs nas bal yul du byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa dbang bzang po'i drung du sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor zlos gar mngon
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 37brjod la byang bar mdzad nas sa skyar byon/ 'phags pa rin po che'i drung du phebs/ shin tu dgyes par gyur/ nged kyi ༄was rje pa byang lhuka kas sprul pa'i sder sku'i bto/da pa bsdu ba'i tshe/ tha ma'i gsung du bka' stsal pa la/da ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang ma sdur+sha ga tu dar bar byas/ brgal brtag gi sprad nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i ro/la bzang 'o/ gdog da/ tha snyad rig gnas kyi tshul 'di la yang lag rjes chen lnga byung bas sems la 'phreng ba cher med/ snyung na kyang 'phags pa bsnyen par ma rje zlogs pa dang /phu ste kas ba༄wad dpag bsam 'khri shing ma 'gyur ba dang / dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i rgyud phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad bzhin ma 'gyur ba gsum tsam ro///zhes gsungs pa zhig 5wad na'ang 'phags pa bsnye na par snyu gas zin/'gyur gnyis sngar ma byung bas da khyed kyis gyis shig /de'i spro/gas dpon chen bzang pos kyang byed pa yod do/ /zhes dgyes bzhin bka' stsal bas/ sa skyar dus 'khor rgyud 'grel shong 'gyur zhes yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa thams cad 'gyur legs pa rang du mdzad pa 'di mdzad/ slar rdo rje gdan du byon nas ma hwa bo rnyi la mchod pa dang bskor ba mdzad/ paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣa mi ka ra spyan drangs nas dpag bsam 'khri shing /klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ snyan ngag me 'o snang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa khri ta mā lā/tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo sbyor ba'i rtsa 'grel/ bzlog pa bsdus pa'i rtsa 'grel/slob dpon su pa rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i smra ba kun la 'jug pa'i rtsa 'grel/slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam dbye'i le'ur byas pa la ro/gas pa lngo don ma 'gyur ba bsgyur//28

40bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbzang po dang / shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'dam pa slo bzang nor bu shā snri/ paṇ+ḍita shrī ma ṇi ka /paṇ+ḍita chos sbyin tsa tu rbe) bcas so/ /zhes smra dgos so//yang /bod du byung ba'i ga lā pa'i mdo dngos ni dpang lo chen pos ( 127641342)bsgyur bar gsungs shing / 'grel pa slob dpon bgrod dka' seng gis mdzad pa dur sing gi le'u bcu gnyis tsam bsgyur/ dur seng gi 'grel pa sku ngas rdzogs ni bu storwa na rin po ches ( 129041364)bsgyur//32nya'adar stod dgra 'dul dbang po'i gsung du/sngar 'o/da du grags pa'i 'o/ rgyus ltar na/ ga lā pa'i kun bshad bzhi pa yan chad ga snyadon nu gde snang drug gis bshad cing //33zhes dang / 'dam pa slo bzang nor bus rang gi gleng brjod du/ga lā pa 'di la kun bshad rkang pa bzhi man gto/na nu ga lnga stong drug gis gsungs pa yin zhes zha lu 'o( chen bzhed kyang / 'phags yul pa'i 'grel pa mkhan 'o/ tshad thub rnams kyis gzhung rangs 1— sharba warmas bshad pa cad da kyi mkhas pa phyi ma dag bzhed de khungs kyang dur seng drangs te/ sharba warmas rnam bshad pa'i/ /rgyud nyung bdag gis rab bshad bya//34

42bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥgzhon nu dpal ( 1392—1481 ) snye thang lo tsā ba slo gros brtan pa/(khong la slo brtan bzhi pa yang zer )zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang 'od ( 1441—1527)kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i ( 1292—1361 )phru slob ma sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen 〈sna 11sa rgyal mtshan la 〈snags pa rnams khu)sa mdzad//37gnyis pa tsa n+d+ra byukar ṇa ni/ skabs shig slob dpon tsan+d+ra gau mi lto phyogs kyi rgyud du 'ongs pa dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud ni ji skad du/bram ze mchong ga sred kyi lha khang na klu la sgra nyan pa'i bskad da pa dang /klu she ṣas byas pa'i pāṇi pa'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yang gzigs pas/'grel pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung ba/ ro ston mang ba/ ma sdugs pa/ tshang ba zhig da spro sa pa yin pa la klu ni rab tu sna snangs te tshig mang ba/ 5wan nyung ba/sdu/sa pa/ ma snyung gas pa'o/ /zhes smad nas/ pāṇi pa'i do sten 'grel du tsa spro byukar ṇa yan lag dang bcas pa mdzad/ gzhung der/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag smyu rmogs//38zhes gsung ba yang klu la zur za bsnya(/ /de nas skabs shig nā la nā ra bzhugs skabs kyi gtam rgyud ni ji skad du/zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan ba༄was kun tu bzang 11 zhes bya ba tshigs bcad legs po zhig gzigs pas rang gis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo sde bas mi legs par mkhyen nas 'bo don mi 'byung snyam

48bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥsnyarmen kyang skad yig zhi 'a'o/ 'gyur gyi rang bzhin la dus rtag tu gnas pas mkhas pa phyi mas mkhas pa snga ma'i gsung ji snyed cig brjod bya rang sor bzhag ste rjod byed bkas bcad sogs dang bstun te slar 'bri byung yang thog ma'i brjod bya'i dbang du byas nas sgyu ma pa 5hwa) mtshan byang la 'gyur ba btang na mi 'grigs par bsam ste snga mo'i ljang da byed dang mi mthun pa byung ba yin srid/ 'o/ rgyus mkhan 'otos tshig sgrorwa sa la brtags te dus puṭā da mi 'grigs pa ji snyed cig byung ba srid pa yin/ma ṇi bka' 'bum la mcho na na bsnyu khad bya'i dbang du byas na 5wang btsan gyis brtsams zhes ra sprod thub nges 'dug kyang rjod byed kyi dbang du byas na srong btsan gyis byas pa min pa'ang ra spro da thub nges 'dug /'a spro sa kyi rang lugs 'a ro gi tshul ni cung zad gsal kha med pa ste/ 'di thad rang lugs 'jog pa'i sgrub byed bzang phra sa ni 'od rgyus kyi yig rnying gang rung zhig tu gsal kha sku da pa zhig ma phyu nga thub pa da spro sa shing / de yang nyung mthar bstan pa snga dar skabs su de'i skor bshad pa zhig nges par du dgos/ de ni da bar su la yang thob kyi med na 'a spro sa la yang gang nas lnga ba/ lhag par 'a spro sa kyis sum rtags rtsa ba dang lnga ga legs sbyar skad lnga ga brtsams pa 'dzam gling rgyan gcig nang gsal/bshad pa shin tu snying rje bo zhig tu snang yang ro ston la ran par shin tu dka'/legs sbyar skad du don ston pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed cig brtsam rung yang bod skad kyi sgra'i bstan ba༄was legs sbyar skad du brtsams pa ni da spro sa pa med pas ma tshad brtsegs yig dang 'phul rten 'jug tshul gru phyin pa legs sbyar du ston du med de/ legs sbyar la bod skad nas bshad pa'i brtsegs yig dang 'phul rten gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ nye rabs kyi brda spro rwad du ma'i nang spro na mis mdzad

50bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥla spro na mi 'thad pa min yang sum rtags gnyis ni sgyu ma 'a po sa nyi tshe ba las nang ro ston gyi cha nas legs sbyar gzhi la byas par da spro ngas tshe mi 'thad par snyam/'gos kyis ma zad 'bras spungs khri zur bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyis kyang rang gi sum rtags nyi zla zung 'jug tu sum rtags gnyis thog mar legs sbyar du brtsams shing / rjes sor bod du bsgyur pa gsungs yod/ 'di dag ni sus bltas kyang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas rjes khas len zhu thabs med pa zhig spro /smra sgo lta bu dang thog legs sbyar skad du brtsams yod kyang chog cing / der sngon rjes kyi stor bshad med pas legs sbyar du brtsams par mi bde ba gang yang med/sum rtags gnyis su sngo snan rjes rnam gzhag dang de dag gi rtags kyi rab dbye nya ro gas bshad 5wad na de dag lnga da skad la mkho ba'i bstan ba༄was kyi thun 〈 snang min pa'i rnam gzhag la brten legs sbyar skad du sgyu ma thabs bral ba lags 5wa//ji ltar legs sbyar gyi 'od mo'i rnam gzhag bod kyi skad yig gi sgros dang mthun pa 〈snab thabs med pa bzhin sbya ste/ /to na mi'i zhal lung nas kyang /de ltar thon mi /bh+yo ṭas rgya gar gyi sgra rig pa dang legs sbyar gyi yi ge 'bri klog la mkhas shing nang byan chud par byas pa/ bod rang gi skad kyi tha snyad sku so dang gdangs kyi nga 1ri rnams la thus gzhig legs par bcug pa'i mthar 5wad yig gsar du ba1— ba'i gzhi legs par btings pa ste ro snags//45yul lung gang gi brda sprod pa yin na yang yul mi'i skad kyi rang gshis la gzhir ba〉〉la te sgrig dbo sa pa yin/ dbyin ji'i mkhas pa ga ge snangs 17gas rā ster ba'i brda spro da brtsams par brten dus phyis bskyar ba༄was byed da spro sa byung
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 51yod kyang bod kyi mkhas pa dang po thon mis bod kyi brda sprod gtan la pheb skabs phyogs ma nor ba'i rkyen gyis brda sprod la bcos 'gyur byed dgos pa byung med/sum cu pa'i bstan bca sa ro gas brtsams skabs tshig 'bo/sa la lar legs sbyar gyi shan zhugs pa ni smra sa mi da spro sa shing / sngo rwan rjes yang gsum dang ma spro can 'dogs can/ tshig sgrub kyi dod rim 5wags gang gi cha nas kyang legs sbyar dang /'brel ba gtan nas med/ sgra gdangs ni skad spyi'i sgra gdangs shig yin pa red/bod skad du mi mkho zhing spyir sngags yig 'a ro rwan pa la mkho ba'i gsal byed mthug log gi yi ge rnams ni kha spra don gyi tshul du bzhag ste nga donas slo tab phyu khang byas dang byed bzhin pa red/gzhan yang brda spro da khro sna gsal dga' storwa na du sum rtags kyi 'grel pa 'ga' zhig gi dpe tho zhig bto da sku da pa ni zha lu ba chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mkhas pa'i yid 'a'o/ga dang 'ong chen nam bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa bstan pa'i 〈snan me ro gas yin/ spro nga gsal 'grel pa rnying pa khag las sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad ma yi ge'i sprod ra ba zhes pa de ni tshe tan zhabs drung nas sum rtags kyi don 'grel du gsungs 'dug kyang / nga tshor 'di yi sngon du sum rtags kyi gzhung thob kyi med pa la brten nas 'di nyid sum rtags kyi don 'grel zhes pa las 'di nyid phyis 'byung gi sum rtags kyi 'grel pa yod do cog gi rtsab lta bur ngos 'dzin byas na skyon e yod snyam//de yang gcig nas da yod sum rtags kyi 'grel pa yongs rdzogs kyi rtsab gang la bzung ba'i gzhung gi tshig phal che ba de'i nang yod pa dang / gnyis nas da lta nga tshor thob pa'i sum rtags kyi rtsab ni bkas bcad kyi rjes su gtan la phab pa'i rtsa
52bod kyi brda sprod nag ṭikaḥtshig cig tu nges pas na 'di nyid lnga na mis brtsams pa yin nges kyang 'o/ rgyus kyi lnga ga nas nges shes 'a5)ngas mi nus/ gsum nas 'di 〈snan 'o/ rgyus kyi yig cha gang du'ang sum rtags mdzad 5wad pa ma gsal ba bcas la brten nas yi ge'i ༈rdzor ba de nyid bod kyi brda sprod kyi rtsab lta bur bzung chog par bdag nyid sems so//'ga' zhig gis rtags 'jug ni rtags kyis 'jug pa'i byed sgra bsdus par da spro ngas kyi/ rtags kyis 'jug pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis gar 'thad kyang rnam dbye bsdus pa'i rjes su rtags 'jug ces pa de rtags kyi 'jug pa'i bsdus ming yin pa ma lha gas rtags kyis 'jug pa'i bsdus ming du 'bo bar dka'/lhag par gzhung phal che ba'i nang rtags kyi 'jug pa zhes bkod yod pa de nyid rang nya sor bzhag na bde bar sems/ grogs wa'i ming la grogs ming bshad kyang rung zhing / gro rwags ya sgos bshad pa la bo/gas bshad mi zer ba bzhin sbya ste//'on kyang nye dus dpar du bskrun pa'i bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo las dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung rab/ mkhan smra kun dga' bzang pos bsgrigs pa'i pod gnyis pa sum rtags dang dag yig gi dpe tshogs su ni sum rtags gnyis sa paṇa gyis brtsams zhes kha sdu na bcad de bto da 'dug na/'di ni dpyad pa dgos pa'i gnad cig tu mngon/ de ltar gong du bshad pa bzhin skal mnyam 'ga' la thugs zhib kyi slad du yi ge'i sku rna 4 7 ra ba sku/ngas rje zlogs 'di gar drangs te sum rtags rtsa ba dang mtshungs bsdur byas pa'i yi ge'i phyung ra ba'i rtsa ba mchan sbrags ma 'di na bzhugs 5wa// deng gi dus su mkhas par :wam pa mi nyung ba zhig nas zhib 'jug gi kho da du sum rtags kyi sna ma pa por dogs slong byed pa de rigs kyi go ba nges can zhig ma rnye da par sum
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 53rtags kyi mdzad pa 'od min par go ba ni sna ga pa shin tu rtsing ba'i gtam du zad/lar nas skye ba snga phyi med pa ma shes par skye ba snga phyi med pa gtan ma 'khol bar brten 'o( rgyus kyi yig char sum rtags mdzad lnga lnga na mi min zhes pa'am/yang na 〈snan mi las gzhan pa zhig sku da ces pa'i yig cha yid sna na 'pher ba ma rnyed bar thon mi'i sum rtags ma red zer ba ni 'odang gtam kho nar zad/ der brten rang gi ma spro la rang gis rma ba lnga rgyu'i las gzhi de mtshams bzhag ste 5wangs grags kyi bshad ro/la de khas blangs na kun dang mthun pas mdzes par sems ro //5yi ge'i 47ra ba'i can ba mchan sbrags ma/lta 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'o// /bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing //rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig ba༄wad pa rnams kyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /(tshigs bcad 'di ni sum cu pa'i brtsam par dam bca' ba yang yin )lha yi ge ming tshig dgos 'brel dang / /'jug tshul bsten tshul bstan bya bdun/ /dbye bsdu de bshad sngon rjes la/ /yul byed tshul ched bzhi bzhi ste//tshul gnyis pa la phrag bcu bdun/ /yan lag bcu gcig yi ge cas/ /ming bcu tshig la brgyad gnyis dgos/ /ldog dang rjes 'gros lus mdor bsdus/ /('di nyid sum rtags kyi ma bar mi gsal )lha yi ge khi/ li kā li gnyis/ /sto/ li gsal byed i 11gas bzhi/ /kā li sum cu tham pa ste/ /(tshigs rkang gsum po 'di rnams sum cu pa'i gzhung dngos kyi rkang pa dang po gsum yang yin )
54bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥ9 sde pa phyed dang brgyad gnas pa/ /('di ni rtags 'jug ma ba'i rkang pa gnyis pa dang mgre(ngas )lha mgrin pa dang ni lce dbus dang / /so bar lce yi rtse mo dang / /mchu dang lce dbus mgrin pa dang / /gnas lnga dag nas 'byung ba ni/ /sde bzhi dag la rim bzhin du/ /mtha' gnyis drug pa'i gsum pa dang / /lnga pa'i lnga/ga gsum bdun pa'i gnyis/ /lnga pa'i bzhi pa mnan bya ba/ /gsum pa gsum dang gcig dang gcig/lhag ma drug ste de ltar na/ /bdun bdun lnga lnga drug tshan la/ /('di rnams sum rtags kyi ma bar med )nya lha 24 dang ma zhing shā rna dang ni/ /shin tu shādzi dang bzhi bzhi ru/ /sde pa bzhi pa yan chad dbye/ /lhag ma bcu bzhi gnas pa la/ /tsa 〈snags gsum ni ca ro/gas sbyar/ /lda ni ba dang sbyar bar bya/ /lhag ma drug ni mo ru sbyar/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ /ma ning mtshan med ces kyang bya/ /(rkang pa dgu po 'di ni rtags 'jug gi tshigs bcad dang spro'i rkang pa bzhi pa dang / tshigs bcad gnyis pa dang gsum pa bcas dang mtshungs pa yin )lha ga zhi yig 'bru kun gyi ro/ga /ming tshig rab tu gsal bar byed/ kho nga nas 'byung ba skye med pa lha re/ /(rkang pa 'di gsum sum rtags ma bar med )lha mo yi yi ge'i nang nas ni/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu dbyung bya/ /'jug pa bcu yi nang nas ni/ /sngo rwan 'jug yi ge lnga dbyung bya/ /('di ni rtags 'jug rtsa ba'i :byogs bcad bzhi pa yang yin )lha mi 'jug pa ni nyi shu snyung/ /(rkang pa 'di ni sum cu pa ma ba'i tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i rkang pa gnyis pa de yin/)༈ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu nyid gas/ /dang po gsum pa lnga pa drug /bdun
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 55pa rnams ni skru tan 'jug lha dza/(rkang pa gsum po 'di ni sum cu pa'i ma ba'i tshigs bcad bzhi pa'i rkang pa dang po gsum dang mtshungs )9 sngon 'jug yi ge lnga po la/ /pho dang ma zhing mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bsnyan ru dbye/ /(rkang pa 'di gsum ni rtags 'jug ma ba'i tshigs bcad lnga pa'i rkang pa dang po gsum yang yin )dang 'od gsum pa gnyis pa ni/ /1wag gnyis gsum pa lnga pa ste/ /bzhi pa de nyid de ltar na/ /(rkang pa 'di rnams sum rtags ma bar mi gsal )༈ de dag re re'ang bzhi bzhi ste/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir byed/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis na/ /(tshigs bcad 'di ni rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba'i tshigs bcad lnga pa'i bzhi pa dang / drug pa'i rkang pa dang po gsum dang mtshungs )lta pho ni 'od bzhi mo bdun la 8 / /dang 'o/ 'od gsum shā sna brgyad la nyo / /gnyis pa 'od gnyis sna bzhi la'o/ /mo ni sna/ lnga ma ning lnga'o/ /shin tu mo ni sna sna bzhi dang //shin tu snang gsum ma ning bzhi lha za/ /('di rnams sum rtags ma bar mi gsal ) lha mi 'jug pa ni 'di dag ste/ /pho ni ma zhing la mi 'jug /mo ni sgyu la 'jug pa min/ /ma ning rang la rang mi 'jug /rang gi sde dang phrad pa na//pho yang mo la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /mo dang mo yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni drag pa'i tshul gyis te/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin//slo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug /shin tu mo ni mnyam pas ro// /ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /ma ning gnyis ka da ltar ched//mo ni bdag dang ma co snerangs phyir/ /shin tu mo ni mnyam phyir 5wa/ /(tshigs rkang bcu bdun po 'di rnams ni rtags 'jug ma ba'i tshigs bcad brgyad pa dang dgu pa/ bcu pa/ bcu gcig /de bzhin bcu gnyis kyi rkang pa dang 5wa bcas yin )
56bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥlta sde pa phyed dang brgyad kro yi/ /dang po gsum pa bzhi pa la/ /mas gnyis drug pa'i gsum pa dang / /bdun pa gas ni sha ma gtorwa shas/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu can de3)/ /(rkang pa lnga po 'di rnams ni sum cu pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i rkang pa gsum pa dang /tshigs bcad gsum pa dang mtshungs/) gsum lnga bcu dang bdun brgyad dang / /gcig gnyis bzhi drug dgu grangs bzhin/ /gsum gnyis lnga yi sde tshan gyis/ /'o/ sna/ ma ning gsum du dbye/ /('di rnams sum rtags ma bar med )༈ de yang dbye ba bzhi bzhi ste/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir byed/ /gang la yi ge thams cad la/ /gang gis bcu po de dag gis/ /ji ltar rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /sgra yi 'jug tshul do sten gyi tshul//rdang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jug /(rkang pa dgu po 'di rnams ni rtags 'jug ma ba'i tshigs bcad bcu bzhi pa'i rkang pa bzhi pa dang / tshigs bcad ba ro lnga/ bcu drug bcas dang mtshungs ) de nas ror+sha na gyi 'jug tshul ni/ /rang rang mthun pa'i mtha' drangs te//(rkang pa 'di gnyis rtags 'jug rtsa bar mi gsal ) rjes 'jug yi ge bcu spro ni/ /ming gang gi ni mthar sbyar ba/ /de la༄gra li bzhi pa sbyar/ /slar bsdu bar ni shes par bya//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu 'od las/ /gang ming mtha' na bcu pa gnas/ /de la lta gra li gnyis pa sbyar/ /gang ming mtha' na brgyad pa gnas/ /de la gnyis pa skru mu yang sbyar//gang ming mtha' na gsum pa gnas/ /de la lta gra li gnyis pa sbyar/ /bzhi pa dgu pa da lngo sa kyang ste/ /las dang ched dang rten gnas dang / /de nyid tshe skabs la sgra yin/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu 'od la/ /i dang mthun lugs 'di lta ste //dang po gnyis la dang po mthun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ /bdun pa nyid ni bdun pa ste/ /lhag ma rnams la gya sbyar ba/ /de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa//
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 57de rnams la ni bcu pa sbyar/ /byed pa 'od ru shes par bya/ /ā li phyis nas gnyis pa sbyar/ /tshig rgyan gnyis dang sdud par 'gyur/ /la don su la u phyis nas//de la gsum pa'i dang po sbyar/ /steng duku| li gsum pas brgyan/ de zhi lhag ma dang bcas pa'o/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po la/ /drug pa sbyar na 'byed sdud yin//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu spro yi/ /bzhi pa dgu pa bcu pa pa (la )/ /sbyar ba 'byung khungs sa yin te/ /dgar dang sdud pa'ang de bzhin yin/ /gang ming brjod pa'i dang po ru/ /kye sbyar ba ni bod par 'gyur/ /gang ming mtha' dang mthun pa yi//bzhi pa la ni i sbyar ba/ /dgar dang bsnan (brnan )pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /ming gang rung ba'i bar mtshams su/ /gsum pa la ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /de ni sdud dang 'byed pa dang / /rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga'o/ /ming gang gi ni ya mtha' ru/ /dang 'od la ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /de ni byed pa'i tshig brgyad 'od//spyi la khyab pa nyid du 'gyur/ /ming gang gi zhi ma tha na/ /pu ling ga yi sgra byung na// cabdag po'i sar ni shes par bya'o/ /ming gang gi ni ya tha na/ /smyu ling ga yi sgra byung na/ /dgag pa'i gnas su shes par bya/ /ming gang gi ni ya tha na//gsum pa la ni e sbyar ba/ /tha snyad dbang du gsum yin te/ /dngos wa'i dbang du bzhi ru sbyar/ /dus kyi dbang du gnyis yin pā ste/ /(tshigs bcad bcu bzhi dang rkang pa gsum 'od 'di rnams sum cu pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs bcad lnga pa'i gsum pa nas nyi shu'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i bar dang tshig ris re zung las phal ro che gcig mtshungs yin/)lha gnyis pa'i bzhi pa phebs brgyan la/ /gsum pa'i gsum sbyar ma 'brel dang //gzhan ldan rnam da cad da da lnga sa rkyen dang / /phyi tshig tha dad min pa lo / / (lnga ) snga gnyis kho na bden bcas 'jug /dang po'i gsum par bdun pa'i gnyis/ /sbyar
58bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥba spyi 'jug gsum pa yi/ /dang po mes brgyan bzhi rjes ldan/ /dmigs 'dzin de gnyis cha ldan te/ kha cig lnga ( snga )phyis zil non sbyar/ /gdags dang brjod pa'i khyad par zhi/ /ka ga pa (ra)ba za sa gnyis/ /la yi yi ge btags pa dang //ka ga nga ja ta da na/ /steng du ra yis brgyan pa dang / /de bzhin sa yis brgyan pa dang / /ka ga nga ca ja ta da/ /steng du la yis brgyan pa ni/ /5ston la tha dad sku rwad pa'i phyir/ /ma bu tha dad gnas pa ni/ /ma yi yi ge chung ba ste/ /bu yi yi ge che ba yin//ba swā khad pa tha dad shes par bya/ /ka kha ga pa pha ba ma/ /de ltar yi ge bdun 11 dang //ka kha ga ca shug cha can/ /zha ra sha sa bcu ga༄5ga dang / /ka kha ga ta da pa pha/ /ba ma sa ha bcu gcig la/ /ya sta ra sta lngag sta gsum/ /go rim bzhin du shes par bya/ /gu lco 'greng bu na 1ri dang / /zhabs kyu kun la 'byung ba yin/ /'dir mang 1—sa pas ci zhig bya/ /chos kyi skad dang mthun pa yis/ /rang yul skad ngan spang bar bya//(tshigs bcad dgu po 'di rnams sum rtags rtsa bar mi gsal na'ang de'i kha 〈snang gal chen zhig tu snang /gang lags she na/ 'di na mgo 'dogs kyi yi ge'i khungs dang skabs de'i mgo 'dogs kyi grangs deng sang dang mi mthun pa gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/)lhu tshigs su bcad la mtshams sbyor rnams/ /cung zad bsdus pa yod na yang / /de ni de bzhin sbyar bar bya'o ( / /(rkang pa gsum po 'di sum cu pa'i tshigs bcad nyi shu pa'i rkang pa phyi ma gnyis dang / nyer gcig gi rkang pa dang 11 rnams kyang yin )lha ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /yi ge kho ngas nas ming 'byung ste //ming gi kho4ngas nas tshig phyung nas/ /tshig gis ro snan rnams lta snan byed pa'o/ /(tshigs bcad 'di ni rtags 'jug ma ba'i tshigs bcad nyer brgyad pa'i rkang pa nyi ma gsum dang / nyer dgu pa'i rkang pa dang po bcas yin )
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 59lha ming la grub dang rjes grub gnyis/ /dang po 'dod rgyal phyi ma la/ /rnam gnyis don ldan brgyad yin te/ /yin dang lnga lnga ra grub pa dang / /da lnga byos po'i rkyen dngos btags pa lnga/ /yod phan byed las 'dra ba 'o/ /tshig gi dbye bsdu byed pa brgyad/ /dngos las byed ched 'byung gnas 'brel/ /gnas dang byed pa'o bsdu ba brgyad/ /'bru mang po dang tshig sdud dang / /bye brag yan lag bzhi bsdu dang / /gzhi gcig skyes bu zlas bsdu ba'o/ /dang po'i tshig mang dang gnyis te/ /de la rang ming ldan mi ldan/ /lhuka kas dang rnam grangs phan tshun bsten/ /drug gi 6wags kun dang gcig la/ /mthun dang tha dad dbye ba bzhi/ /phye la phyed pa drug gis bsgyur//brgyad dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi las/ /dus gcig gsum ldan nyid du sbyar/ /('di rnams sum rtags kyi ma gzhung du mi gsal na'ang tshig sdud kyi khungs ston pas shin tu gnad chen spro yin )lha mo yi yi ge med pa na/ /pho yig bsnyu da pa med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang / /'jug par bcas pa med na zhi/ /ming dang tshig kyang gas la mi nus/ /ming tshig gsal ba med na ni/ /5snan rnams ba༄wad par mi 'gyur 1ri//de ltar 'gyur na 'jig rten gyi/ /(tshigs bcad 'di gnyis rtags 'jug ma ba'i tshigs bcad nyer dgu'i rkang pa phyi ma gsum dang / tshigs bcad sum cu pa/ ro gcig gi rkang pa dang 5sna rnams dang mtshungs/)lta sems can rnams ni bde bar 'gyur/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa sbyar pa cos//(yi ge'i sbyor ba'i gzhung 'di na tshigs bcad phyed dang nga brgyad yod pa las phyed dang so bzhi ni sum rtags kyi rtsa tshig tu'ang gsal/ cas ba'i sum rtags kyi cad tshig tu tshigs bcad phyed dang re gsum 54da pas na de dag las brgya cha nga gnyis yi ge'i 1 ster ba na'ang gsal ba yin/ yi ge'i lha ster ba'i rgyung ba 'di yi ma phyi ni gangs can rig mdzod danpa'i sna ga 11sa 550 nas 560 bar bzhugs 54da/ sa rā 11da kyi ma17 rim 〈snab gnyer khang gi 〈snab da1—na ba ro sned nams rgyal mtshan lags kyis cand kyi brda 11da pa yi ge'i 1 ) ra ba'i 'grel pa smra ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs
60bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥso zhes pa'i yi ge'i sbyor ba'i rgyas 'grel phun sum tshogs pa zhig brtsams yod/ 'on kyang deb 'di nyid kyi kha byang du ni bod kyi brda sprod slo gsal rig pa'i gsang mdzod ces bkod yod/ deb kyi logs der 'di nyid deb phreng ka pa yin pa yang 'khod yod/ deb phreng dang po de ni gnas brgyad chen mo'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa/ mchan 'grel/de bzhin smra sgo'i 'grel pa slo gsal rig pa'i rol rtsed bcas yin )6brda ༄sted 'grel pa snga phyi bshad pa/lha sum rtags kyi 'grel pa dbus pa blo gsal gyis mdzad pa de ni da bar sum rtags kyi 'grel byed su gang ga'ang thob med par brten dpe tho tsam du zad/'o/ chen nam bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa bstan pa'i spro na me dang zha lu ba phyur+shas legs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mkhas pa'i yid 'a11ga ni da lta bdag gi lag tu 5wan ma byung na'ang phyis kyi 'grel pa mang po'i nang du lung 'dren byas sku/da par brten de snga mkhas pa mang 'o/sa gzigs rgyo khang snyo snad/ des na dbus pa khrar gsal gyis mdzad pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa de ni da sku dod yig cha las khungs skyel thub pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa la snga ba de yin par sems/de nas rim bzhin 'ong chen nam bzang gi sum rtags 'grel pa bstan pa'i 〈snan me dang / snar thang lo tsā ba ba ji shrī'i sum rtags mchan 'grel/ yar 'brog pa rin chen do tag gi sum rtags 'grel pa rin 11 che'i za ma lta sten /paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i ( 140041475)sum cu pa'i 'grel pa zhib snang rnam 'thag /spros 11 rab 'byams pa ba ro/da nams seng ge'i ( 142941489)rtags 'jug gi nī ka
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 61dge ye ba tshul khrims seng ge'i sum rtags 'grel pa nyi ma'i 'od zer/ paṇa chen shākya mchor+shaka ldan ( 142841507)gyi phyur+shas la 'jug pa'i sprod/ a mes zhabs kun dga' ba ro/da nams kyi legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba/ zha lu 'od chen (1441—1527)gyi sum rtags 'grel pa rnam par gsal ba'i legs bshad/paṇa chen gser ma ro rwa ka can pas mdzad pa'i sum rtags 'grel pa/ dpa' lnga gtsug lag phreng ba'i ( 150441566)sum rtags 'grel pa gsal byed sgro don me/zur mkhar ba 〈 sna spro sa rgyal kro'i ( 1509)sum rtags 'grel pa mkhas pa'i dga' 〈snan/ rab 'byams smra ba mār+shas rgyal gyi sum rtags 'grel pa lhom gsal mgul rgyan/'ol phrug ga rma rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i sum rtags 'grel pa mkhas pa'i rgyan/sman lung ba slo mchog rdo rje'i ( 159541671 )sum rtags 'grel pa zung 'jug snang byed yid kyi shing rta/ zha lu chos legs kyi mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog/gting skyes cong gas ga〈snag pa blo bzang snar+shas grags kyi sum rtags 'grel pa gsal rtsoba'i sgron me bcas la :wan gyi 'grel pa rnying ma zhes pa'i mtshan thorwa gas 5wad/de dag las 'ga' re ma gto snags phag che ba'i dpe rgyun rgya bo rwad gnyis gar da to/na par snang ngo //de nas rnam gling paṇa chen da torwa na ma phyu ga co sa grags kyi sum rtags 'grel pa legs bshad snang byed nor bu/( 1683 lor brtsams/) pu s+t+ri dge bshes rin chen ro ston grub kyi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa kun tu bzang po'i da spro ngas rgyan dang rtags 'jug bshad sbyar tshigs bcad ma/ ca'e na grags pa bshad sgrub ( 167541748)kyis mdzad pa'i sum rtags 'grel pa tshig do ston gsal byed snang ba/ ga rma si tu gtsug lag 4stos kyi snang ba'i ( 170041774)sum rtags 'grel chen mkhas
62bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥpa'i mgul rgyan mu nyig phreng mdzes/ a kya khro sna bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan( 170841786)gyi sum rtags 'grel pa blo spro sa pad mo sna 'byed pa'i snang ba/lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i sum rtags 'grel pa slo ldan dga' skyed/ ga rma smonlam 'od zer gyi sum rtags 'grel pa legs bshad snang ba dam pa/ bsam gtan ro snan grub kyi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa da lha ngas ro na gsal ba'i me 'o snang /ma〈snad dge blo bzang seng ge'i ( 1712—1780)sum rtags 'grel pa blo ldan dga' skyed/ a kya sku ngas 'dzin dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo sna 〈snas kyi rtags 'jug rab gsal snang ba dang / rnam dbye bya byed ro/gas kyi dka' gnad gsal ba'i me 'odang / bdag gzhan bya byed las gsum nyung gsal 'phrul gyi lde mig/lta rwa rgya dge 'dun shes rab kyi sum rtags 〈snan 'grel me lta ga phreng mdzes/dngul chu dharma bha dra'i ( 1772—1851 )sum rtags 'grel pa si tu'i zhal lung / dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i sum cu pa'i snying po legs bshad 〈snan pa'i dbang 11 dang / rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad gsal ba'i me 'o/nga /ga༄zlas gser khri blo bzang rgyal mtshan seng ge'i ( 175741849)sum cu pa'i 'grel pa nyin mo'i snang ba dang / rtags 'jug 'grel pa pā ra bu'i rgyan phreng /bde thang mkhan 'od 〈 sna bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi sum rtags 'grel pa tam bu ra'i sgra dbyangs/ a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyi sum rtags 'grel pa skal ldan yid kyi pad ma 'byed pa'i snang ma snyu pyod/ dga' bzhi ba ldo ring ba ro/da nams bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor tshe ring gi sum rtags 'grel pa ut+pa la'i rna rgyan/gser 〈snag blo sna bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i ( 184541915)sum rtags 'grel pa 'ong mtshar 'phrul gyi lde mig /mer gon mkhan 〈sna se ra ba ye shes rnam
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 63rgyal gyi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa legs bshad rin chen rgyud mangs/ ngag dbang thub bstan gyi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba/ mer gen chor+shas rje'i pra sti'i dgongs pa gsal byed spro na me/ rnga snyad da nam seng gi sum rtags 'grel pa slo ldan dga' skyed/ zhal shul tshang gi sum cu pa'i 'grel pa rin chen lde mig/dme shul chos 'phel gyi sum rtags 'grel pa rmongs mun 'joms pa'i nyi 'od/ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyi rtags 'jug 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i co byo rgyun/ ba5wad nams rgya mtsho'i rtags 'jug 'grel pa ma lnga nga ba don ldan/ spangs lung ba kun bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i sum rtags 'grel pa 'phrul lde sku/gas la phyis kyi 'grel pa gsar ma zhes pa'i tha snyad stodags pa yin//dus phyis dus rabs nyi shu pa'i smad dang dus rabs nyer gcig gi 'gor rang re'i bod kyi shes rig gnam sa mgo rting log pa lta bu'i gnas stangs shin tu zhan par gyur pa'i skabs su'ang / rang re'i shes rig gi rtsab rmeg med du ma song bar mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig byung yod pa dang chabs cig bod kyi brda sprod 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi thog la'ang gzhis byes mkhas pa rnams nas smag la spro na me btegs pa bzhin du sum rtags 'grel pa tshar du dngar ba mdzad pa las grags che ba 'ga' zhig 'di lta ste/dkyil grwa dka' chen pad+ma'i legs bshad ljo na dbang gi 'grel chung blo gsal lnga sa 'dzin dbang por 'jebs pa'i brda sprod tshig gi gling bu zhes bya ba dang / rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long sga 'grel pa rigs lam gser gyi lde mig ces bya ba/ sum cu pa'i zur rgyan legs bshad pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/tshe tan zhabs drung gi sum rtags kyi bshad pa lnga na mi'i zhal lung / bar gzhis phun
64bod kyi brda sprod nag ṭikaḥtshogs dbang rgyal gyi 'grel gsar gser btso ma/ dge bshes blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sum rtags kyi rgyas bshad brda spro rwad rin chen bang ma ljand/ dmu dge bsam gtan gyi brda 1—da khro rna gsal dga' storwa na/ mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyi sum cu pa'i rnam bshad gzur gnas dgyes pa'i gtam dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel gnad kyi sgron me/ mdo smad pa dge 'dun sbyin pa'i sum rtags legs bshad nyin byed kyi snang ba/ dod rje rgyal po'i sum rtags kyi snying 'grel legs bshad 'dren pa'i 'od nya/'ba' pa skal bzang 'gyur med kyi 5wad kyi brda spro rwad rig pa'i khrid rgyun rab gsal me 'o/nga / slob da lnga don chen 'o/ thub bstan mchor+shaka sgrub kyi lnga dod kyi sgra rig pa'i gnas la da phru khad pa gsal ba'i me 'o/nga / 5war zhi ga ro stong drug snyems blo'i brda spro da rig thi'i don 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ slob dpon chen po mkhas dbang slo bzang dbang phyug gi bra ti'i zhal lung pad+ma dkar po dang mtha' da lho tad rig pa'i zla zer/〈snab da5wan 'a spro/sa pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi gleng ba༄wad chen mor 'dzam gling rgyan gcig/lcags thar rgyal gyi yarwa da kyi brda sprod da spyi rnam 'phrul rig snang ma snyund/ chab mdo shes rab kyi sum cu pa'i spyi don thon mi'i snying thig dang de'i mtha' dpyod thon mi'i 'dzum zer/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel lnga na mi bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs/tshe dbang lha mos sngon med rig pa'i 'phrul shel/ 'bras spungs mkhan khri sgo mang gung ru bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyis sum rtags rtsa tshig gi dka' gnad gsal byed nyi zla zung 'jug /slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bod kyi brda sprod blo gsal rig pa'i gsang ma snyund deb phreng gnyis/ be ri dge bshes 'jigs med dbang rgyal gyi rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam bshad mkhas pa'i dbo ngas rgyan/'phags yul kirti byes pa grwa tshang gi sgyu ma deb brgya pa sum cu pa'i mtha' dpyod
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 65rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchor+sha da sprin/ glang ri ba thub bstan sbyin pa'i ro snad skad kyi brda sprod gsar bsgrigs smra sgo'i lde mig la ro/gas pa du ma sku/da na //gong gsal 'grel pa snyo da do pu ga las mchog tu gyur pa ni si tu paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan mu tig phreng mdzes de yin par mkhas pa mang che bas khas len gyi yod cing / don la yang de ltar gnas yod/'grel pa 'di nyid 'grel pa gzhan thams cad las ma ༄ r+sha ga tu gyur pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ga ro sta bo ni 'di nyid lung rigs kyis tshul bzhin du bkral bar ma zad 'jig rten pa'i nye bar phruld pa la yang da spro ngas pa zhib tu bzhes sku da pas yin/dbu phar gyi gzhung lugs la thorwa sa bsam rnal ma byas rjes brda spro da kyi gzhung lugs la lnga sa bsam de tsam ma byas kyang 〈 r+sha ga par bsam pa gang zhig nas brda sprod la bshad pa byed skabs lung rigs kyis tshul bzhin du bkral ba'i dbang du btang na yang 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod zer na gang 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod pa ma shes te rang gis sum rtags kyi spro ro na spo rwa ka par bkral bar ma zad rje si tu'i 'grel chen lta bu'i gzhung lugs tshad ldan rnams la phyo gas snga'i nam ma langs gong nas dgag pa'i nyi ma shar ba de 'dra sngon chad kyang byung yod cing /dus deng sang yang 'ong dang 'ong bzhin pa de ltar snang / slob dpon mkhyen rab 'od gsal nas kyang rang gi rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel gnad kyi ༄wan mer 'di ltar gsungs te/yang mkhas ming 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gis ni kho sna rang gis ma1—nga stongs kyi yul du ma gyur pa'am/ yang na don 'di ni 'di dang 'di'o zhes
66bod kyi brda sprod nag ṭikaḥkha tshon gcod pa'i nus pa dang mi ldan tshe/ dbu tshad sogs gzhung gzhan gyi bshad yam mang spro zhig mi 'brel bzhin du tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la sbyar te gang dpyad bya'i don de nyid rtogs dka' ba dang /kha tshon gcod mi rung ba/ mtha' med pa/ grangs med pa/ gtan khol med pa ro rwags bshad de gzhan rnams ma po sna 〉zu smra snangs su bcug nas slo gros gsar bu pa dag gi rnam dpyod kyi sgo mo 'gog pa'i thabs la bsna na pa de 'dra mi gnang bar 'tshal/ de bas the chon ma gyi dri ma rnams dpyad gsum sgya chab kyis legs par bkras te da gad smra ba'i slo mo phye zhig/46 ces gsal//—7lnga don mi'i rnam thar rgan rabs ngag rgyun/ga yab a nu snang grags dang yum dbyangs can lha mo gnyis kyi sras su phyi 'o/ brgya phrag bdun pa'i 'go stod du 'khrungs pa'i yi ge'i byed po ni bod kyi lo rgyus su grags pa'i mdzangs slon bzhi pa de yin/ thon mda' sman lo/nga pas mdzad pa'i snyu na mi'i rnam thar 'di na bzhugs ro///de yang / snye mo thon khul rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun kha gtam shod grol du/sngon gyi dus lto kha gnyal nang khyim tshang phyug kro zhig la bu spun gsum yod pa'i rgan pa dkar sku dol ba1— las 〈snags lag shes la shin tu mkhas pa zhig sku dod pas 'byor pa che ba zhig yod/ bu 'bring po de bon chos dang gto bcos sogs bcos thabs la shin tu mkhas pa zhig sku/da/ bu chung kro snas ku5 nu snang grags zhes bya ba zhig
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 67yod pa de dbang 'o/ brtul bas gcen 5wa gnyis kyis sku/na tan bslabs kyang mi shes par brten/ pha ma nas rgyun du gshe bas yid bsun te yul gyar nas rim gyis snye mo khul thon lug rwa bsam 'grub sgang du phebs te lda chu zhig gi khar ngal bsos nas bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ a ma zhig der chu len du yong ba dang dus 'grigs/a mas bu de mtho dong ma thag sems dga' ba zhig byung nas 'di skad ces/bu khyod ga nas yong / ji byed du 'gro sogs dris pas/ a nu snang grags nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib tu bsnyad pas/ 'o na nga'i nang la bu mo dbyangs can lha mo zer ba zhig yod pas de dang khyim thab byas nas khyod 'dir sdod dam zer ba bzhin zhal gyis bzhes nas57 ma dang lhan du khyim la 47na/ nang gi pha la yang rgyu mtshan zhib par bshad pas yid 'thad par byung ste/ bu mo dbyangs can lha mo dang khyim thab byas/ nam zhig na bu mo sprum mar gyur pa'i tshe khyim der 'ja' zug pa dang /ri dwags sogs kyis bskor ba byed pa/ dri bzang po thul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba dang / lhag par yum gyi sma lam du nang pa'i dge slong glegs bam dang ral gri 'dzin pa zhig phebs te gnas tshang g.yar po thongs gsung nas rang nyid la thim par rmis pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas a nu saṃ lho ṭa 'khrungs/ a nu zhes pa lha kha bas bu chung shos la a nu zhes brjod srol yod 'dug /bu de lo gsum la phebs pa'i skabs su yab a nu snang grags nas bu chung de 'khyer nas zhing rmo ru phebs pa'i skabs yab kyis lwa bo de phud nas de'i nang bu chung de bzhugs su bcug /zhing rmod bzhin pa'i skabs/ gang nas 5wang ma shes pa'i mi gzi brjid chen 5wa rta ngang pa 'o don pa/mda' gzhu 'kho ra gsum can zhig 〈 sna bur du byung ba des yab la 'di skad ces/
68bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥnga 'o / shes sam gsungs pas mi shes lags zhus pas/ snyu sdi na nga 'o/da kyi rgyal 5wa sku/nga btsan sgam kro yin/ ngas dri ba byed par gan thebs na bya dga' dang ma thebs na chad pa gcod/ drang por ma spros na ske gcod do gsungs nas dri ba gnang bar/snyu da kyi zhing kha ga dus sna sa gsung pas/ da nang codakas pa nas stso/sa pa yin zhus pas/ yang khyod kyi zhing kha la rmos rol rkang ga tshod byung yod grangs ka shod dgos gsungs par/ yab kyis grangs ka zhu rgyu med pas skrag ste mgo 'phur lce bsnar/rngul chu 'dzags bzhin bsdad pa'i skabs su/ yab kyi lwa bo'i nang yod pa'i bu chung lo gsum pa de yar gangs nas rgyal 'od la 'di skad ga ro la ba/ rta chad sbang ba gdo/nga sa dang / mi chad ya la bzhag sa nga'i pa pha e yin/ de 'dra yin na rgyal po khyod da nang gnas tshang nang phebs nas rta'i rmig rjes ji tsam bzhag yod dam/de'i grangs ka gsungs na nga'i pa pha'i zhing la rmos rol rkang grangs ngas zhus chog gsungs pas rgyal 'od thugs mnyes nas/ nga la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa'i bu de da rnyed byung / bu nga la dgos/ yab khyod rang lwa wa gyon gsungs nas/rgyal 5was zhing sa sbar ba gang yab kyi pang kha'i nang la gnang ste nang du ma slebs par kha ma 'phye/ 'di lta5 ma'i nu rin yin/ nang mi rnams la yang rgyu mtshan de skad spros shig gsungs nas/ bu de rgyal spro'i chibs pang du bsnams nas yud tsam zhig la gar ro nga med par phebs/ yab nas nang mi rnams la rgyu mtshan zhib par bshad pas sa sbar ba gang 'di a ma'i nu rin la sprad byung zer nas bltas pas gser phye sbar ba gang du gyur nas 'dug /chos rgyal gyis dri ba mdzad pa'i sa zhing der deng sang yang zhing dri ba chen mo zhes ming 'bod kyi 'dug/47
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 69slog slob dpon gyi bod yig 'khrid thabs/༄༅rgya/ /nga tsho tshang ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su slob mkhan sha stag yin par brten/ thog mtha' gnyis kyi bya bar shin tu gal chen 'dzin dgos/thog ma'i bya ba ni kun stso dong bzang 'od ba༄was rgyu dang mtha' ma'i bya ba ni gzhan don du bsngo sna ba sgyu don lam rnam par dag pa zhig byed rgyu de yin/ lnga da kyi gtam dper/ tshes gcig nas 'phyugs na gnam sgang bar/ zhes gsung ba bzhin nga choms phru gu ker yi ge sku don tan kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa de nyid phru dob kyi sku/da pas dang thog nas go rim ma 'khrugs pa dang / tshad gzhi mang nyung ma 'dzol ba/dus yun ring thung 'tsham pa/ phru gu'i khams dang rig pa/ de bzhin lo na'i bab dang bstun mkhas pa zhig da spro sa/ phru gur nam yang ma snyu nga chung dang khyad gsod/ brnyas ba༄was/ dma' 'bebs rigs nam yang byed rgyu med cing / lha rab byung na phru gu re re nas rang gi sha nas mched pa'i phru gu yin bsam pa dang /phru gu re re nas sprul pa'i sku yin pa'i bsam pa bskyed thub pa gnang dgos/ ror+sha na du yang nga chogs lnga ma shes pa tsam ma ga lta ( kas phru gu re re nas nga tsho'i brtse ba'i a ma lan grangs ga tshod byas pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod pa yin pa gsung rab yod do cog nas gsung bzhin yod/ de ltar byung na mdzod las gsungs pa bzhin/cho gis sbyin lho snan mo ngas can min pas/ /ma ro dra gas yang dag ji bzhin stodzin//zhes pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs par re//de bzhin phru gu re re la sprul pa'i sku yin pa'i 'du shes skye thub na rang bzhin gyis phru gu rnams la mthong dang / re ba/ yid ches ngang gis 'phel gyi red/
70bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbsam slo 'di 'dra zhig btang ba'i sgo nas khyed dge rgan rnams kyis slob phrugrnams la legs par ma nor ba bslabs thub pa yin na slob gnyer don dang ldanpa 'ong bar ma zad/ khyim tshang dang / grong lde/ grong khyer/ rdzong khag mnga' sde/rgyal khab/ 'dzam gling 5wangs rdzogs la phan lnga gas thub pa'i skyes bu nus ldan sha stag gso skyo steng thub pa'i re ba byed dor+shaka lar nas dge gon rnams kyis slob 'khrid gnang skabs slob yul su yin min la ltos med kyis slob 'khrid gnang gi yod pas da spro ngas pa bzhed stangs to/nga gsal bzhin byung na ba ro da nams rlabs 5wa che gsog pa'i rgyu ru yang nges par du 'gro nges yin/ 'di yi go don ni phru gur cha langs gtong rgyur go mi rung / phru gur tshogs gtam rtsa ba nas gtong mi rung ba'i ro ston yang min/ de bzhin da spro sa gal la gzhig pa'i phru gur nyes pa gdo nga mi rung ba'i dorwa na yang gtan nas min/ don gas gtam mi da spro sa pa dang /nyes pa gtong mi dgos pa byung na ni shin tu legs/ skabs re phru gur lam nor las ldog phyir btsan stabs kyis thabs lam bsten dgos pa'ang srid/ de 'dra'i gnas skabs su phan sems dang snying rje'i sgo nas tshogs gtam dang nyes pa gtong da〈stos byung na phan pa las ga pā stod pa med pa nga phyugs shes thub pa yin//dper na mchor+sha ga sprul rnams la dge rgan rnams nas phyag 'jug gnang ba'i rnam thar dang pha ma rnams kyis rang gi phru gur chu ma 5wang spro/nga nas rag dang rkyen ma sku nga bo/nga nas zlo sna ka pa'i tshul du 〉rgags gtam dang nyes pa gto snang ba mthun rkyen du song ba ji snyed cig ma snyu nga du 5wad/ stabs ma legs pa zhig la 'ga' zhig gis 'dzin skyong nas phru gur cho7gas gtam dang nyes pa gtodang mi chor+shaka pa'i lam ston gnang bar khrims su bzung nas phru gu rnams yal bar dor na chog pa dang /
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 71tshogs gtam dang nyes pa gtong na mi chog par dgongs mkhan ji snyed cig byung ba'i rkyen gyis dra rwab phrug dang dge rgan dbar 'brel ba yag 'od ma byung ba yang nga tshos mthong du yod na 'di rigs la gzab dgos// rislob ma'i ngos nas kyang mdo las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nang chos slob 'khrid byed skabs stod kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba zhig dgos zhes brjod kyi 5wad/ dang po sdod kha sprub pa'i skyon ni/ legs par zhes pa'i tshig gis bstan cing / slob sbyong la don gnyer med pa'i skyod na yin/ phru gu rnams la lha khan de rang bzhin gyis sleb kyi sku da/de 'dra'i gnas skabs su phru gur tshogs gtam dang dma' 'bebs byed rgyu'i tshab tu slob spradang la dga' ro snas sku/nga ba'i kho ra yug cig bskrun thabs gnang dgos/stod kha sbub pa de kha yar 〈snang ba'i thabs lam zhig nges par du 'don la da spro sa/'di ni slob sbyong la don gnyer mi zhugs pa'i gegs che shos su snang // ltade nas slob phrug gi gnas tshad dang bstun te slo rwa ba spro nga byed pa'i phan 5wan dang ma byed pa'i nyes dmigs shig sen ra spro da thub pa da spro sa/ de yang sgrub phyogs nas gnas skabs kyi phan 1—gas dang mthar thug gi phan sku/na/ rang la 〈snas pa'i phan yon dang gzhan la ltarwa smra nas kyang phan yon 5wad pa/ mis slon rang skyid 'ong ba/ gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi da sprodas pa/ btab sar smin pa 'ong thub pa/mi tshe don dang ldan pa/ sad smin snyung gas gsum 'ong thub pa dang / dgag phyogs nas chung dus phru rwab sprodang yag po ma gnang na spro nga gsal 5wan tan rnams kyi lde ga phyogs tag tag 'ong gi 〈 snad pa'i gnas tshul chu ma 5wang gong nas rag dang rkyen ma yong gong nas torwa ka pa'i tshul du gseris dkrol gnang dgos par sems/
72bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥgal te skyon dang po de sel thub na slob sbyong la don gnyer ngang gis 'ong zhing /de nas slob sbyong la rang ngos nas shugs rgyab rgyu de 'ong gi yod/ me tog rang bzhad bzhin du dzārwa ba sbyo steng la rigs sad nges lags/ nam zhig rigs sad na de nas smin pa dang rdzogs pa gnyis kyang lhan skyes kyis 'ong bar nges so//gnyis pa spra sted dri mas bslad pa'i skyo sten yin/ 'di ni rab tu 〉 na la zhes pa'i tshig gis bstan cing / skyon de phru gu phal che bar yong gi med/ gal te yod na dri ma sel bar byed pa'i thabs lam 'tshol dbo sa/ bod kyi gtam gyi dper/ nga rgyal gyi bo nga bu la sku na tan gyi chu mi chags lta ba'i gtam dpe'i lam nas phru gu'i nga rgyal ga〉〉ga thabs la 'bad dgos so/ /gsum pa ni stod zhabs ro la ba'i skyo tan yin/'odi ni yid la zungs shig ces pa'i tshig gis bstan cing / de ni phru gur las sla spro'i thog nas yong gi yod/ khu nu rin po ches rgyal ba rin po cher/ yang yang ma 'dris brtson 'grus skyon/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yang nas yang du sbyong dgos pa yin/ de nas stod zhabs rdol ba der lhan pa glan pa dang gnyis su med par skyon de dang bral bar 'ong / chu shing bstan bcos las/ yon tan dang po slob dka' la//shes bzhin med na nyams par sla/ /chu thigs ga ro/ga pa 'gengs dka' yang //bo na cig car nyid du 'dzad/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no//sa skya legs bshad las kyang / mkhas pa stsod ba pa'i dus na sdug /bde bar sgyu da la mkhas mi srid/ /bde ba chung la chags pa des/ /chen ngo'i bde ba lnga ba mi srid/ /ces dang / rje gung thang gis kyang / nyin re zas kyang mi dran bsgyu na 'grus ltam/ /zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i 〈sna 'phang 'an stod/ /zhag gsum lon tshe rjes med g.yeng bas 'khyer/ /de 'dra de la ci yang mi 'ong bas//
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 73bsna na pa chu ro'i rgyun bzhin bsten cig gang / /zhes gsung lngar / /gzhan yang /sum cu pa las/ bslab la bsna na pa'i gang zag gis/ /dang 'od nga lnga rnams la sbyongs/ /sngon 'jug ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum/ /klog gi ched du bslab pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bzhi yi 47ra ba ni/ /mnyan bsam bstan pa'i lnga sten du sbyar//yan lag de dag mthu yis ni/ /'bras bu'i ched du ro don la dbab/ /bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du spro la bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dang por 'di nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te//bslab pa gang la dad pa yis/ /gzhung nyid bla ma dag las mnyan/ /slo rwa ba da'o/na de nyid du 'dzin cing / /le lo g.yeng ba rnam par spongs/ /zo bzang dad pa la brten pa//skyes bu des ni myur rtogs te/ /de la dus su 'doms par bya/ /cig shos de las ldog pa lo / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ kli ga sli ba da yarwa na gyi drung nas stsoto ba gnyer 'go tshugs ji ltar 'dzugs dgos pa dang / tshul ji ltar byed dgos pa/de la brten nas 'bras bu bde blag tu ji ltar son nus pa/ de yi ched du slob phrug gi spyod lam ji ltar skyong dgos pa sogs shin tu gsal bar byung ba'i dbang gis 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab gzhan kun dang mtshungs par 'o skyod mi rnams kyang shes rig thad gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa byung 5wad//de bzhin phru gu mir phru sted lam la mdo stan na yang / phruld 'jug shes bzhin le'ur gsungs pa ltar khor yug gtsang ma nyar stangs dang / za ma za stangs/bab col bya mi rung ba sogs kyi bslab byar nan tan gnang dgos/ ji skad du/so shing dang ni mchil ma dag /ro ster ba na ni dgab par bya/ /gci la sku gas pa'ang longs spyod pa'i/ /chu dang thang la dor ba smad/ /ces dang / kha bkang ba dang sgra
74bod kyi brda sprod nag ṭikaḥbcas dang / /kha gdangs nas ni za mi bya/ /rkang pa brkyangs te mi 'dug cing //lag pa mnyam par mi mnye'o/ /'jig rten ma dad gyur pa kun/ /ma snyu nga dang dris te spang bar bya/ /zhes dang / khri la 5wags pa bab ༄wal du/ /sgra dang bcas pa mi dor ro/ /sgo yang drag tu mi dbye ste/ /gcom bskyungs rtag tu dga' bar bya//zhes gsungs sku da/ sngo na gyi mkhas grub spro nga ma rnams kyi shes rig gi gnas stangs 'byung 'gyur mi rabs rnams kyis mi nyams spro nga 'phel dang nyams pa sor chud pa'i khar deng dus dang mthun pa'i slob gnyer gnas tshad long nges shig 'ong ba'i 'go 'dzugs ni da lta nga rang tsho'i mdun na yod pa'i slob phrug rnams kyi slob gsor rag lus/ nga tshos ma 'phyugs na 'byung 'gyur gyi mi rabs nya kyis 'phyugs mi srid de gas 'bras slu med yin pa'i phyir/ nga 49sa 'phyugs na ni de las rdzog ste 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i nges pa ga la yod de med pas so//lha rab byung na dge rgan rnams kyis lho ba 'khrid gnang ba'i skabs dang bstun te phru gu'i mdun nas gsar pa mi nyung ba zhig shes thub pa da〈stos//phru dab khrid thad shin tu gal che ba'i gnas tshul rang dran pa zhig zhus na/dge rgan gyi skyongs nas rang nyid dge rgan yag 'od zhig yin pa 〈snab phrug gi mdun du ma lnga na lkog rgyab mdun med pa lta na thub pa zhig dang / slong ba phrug rnams kyi lnga sa nas dge rgan gyi mdun du rang nyid slo rwa ba phrug yag ya sna zhig yin pa lnga phag dbyer med storwa na thub na de nas slob gnyer la phal cher bar chad yong mi srid pa lta bur mngon//sa skya legs bshad las kyang 'di ltar gsung ste/ legs bshad byis pa dag las kyang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis sku(ngas su len/ /dri zhim byung na ri dwags kyi//
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 75lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ /zhes dang / yang slob phrug rig pa zhan pa rnams la yal bar dor ba'i shes yon gyi lam srol zhig kyang deng gi dus su dar bzhin pa lags na/ 'di ni thabs la mi mkhas par sems ro / /ji skad du/ shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun 11 sku/na tan mi 〈 rwa ba 'o// /brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis/ /blun pos 'bad pa lhag pa dgos/ /zhes dang / yon tan med pa'i skyes bu la ni dpe ltar mi rung ba yin/ de ji skad du/ blun po slob pa ngo mtshar 'dzin//mkhas rnams mi 〈snab 'ong mtshar 'dzin/ /des na mkhas rnams mkhas gyur kyang //phyi ma'i don du rig pa slob/ /ces gsung pa las bslab bya blangs te bslab pa slob gnyer 'chi la mngon du phyogs pa'i gnas skabs kyang dor mi rung na rang dgar ga la dor du rung / ji skad du/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab//tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bsgu la ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so// caspyir na slob sbyong gnang skabs/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ dgag bzhag snrur+shang gsum/ mang dang lnga sa pa/ mang nas lnga/sa pa/mang du 1snas pa/ ma1—nga nas nges pa/ skru snag nas nges pa/ 'dris nas nges pa/myong nas nges pa/ dpe'i 〈 sna nas nges pa/ ri mo'i lam nas nges pa/ sgyu ga brnyan gyi lam nas nges pa/ byed sgo'i lam nas nges pa/ sgrung gi lam nas nges pa/'khyab sto snan gyi lam nas nges pa/ phru kar sbyang gi lam nas nges pa/ brtag dpyad kyi lam nas nges pa/ dri ba dri lan gyi lam nas nges pa/ 'ong rgyus bshad pa'i lam nas nges pa/ ched las mkhas pa gdan 'dren zhus pa'i lha nas nges pa/zab 47nga gi lam nas nges pa/ gsung bshad kyi lam nas nges pa ro/gas ji snyed
76bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥcig yod du chug kyang rab dang phul du gyur pa de ni phag cher rang gi dngos su cha shas blang pa'i sgo nas don gnad cig shes par byed rgyu de yin//sprarwa ba gso'i deb ga ge snang zhig nang / rgan lags khyed kyis nga la slo rwa ba 'khrid gnang na ngas shes sa ma red/ rgan lags khyad kyis nga la dngos su dpe ston mdzad na ngas cung zad shes sa red/ rgan lags khyed kyis nga la dngos su slob tshan de byed bcug na de nas ngas gzhi nas shes sa red ces bshad smra la 〈snad/〈snang gsal 'di dag ni thabs lam tsam zhig yin pa las yag do snas dang sdug shos kyi 'grel brjod byed mi rung / phru gu'i khams dang shes rab/ slob tshan gyi rang bzhin/ kho ra yug gi mthun rkyen mang 'o/ zhig gi dbang gis rigs gcig la mthabs lam rmad du byung ba de rigs gzhan la de las lde ga tu 'gyur ba de 'dra'ang yong srid pa yin/ chos dang 'jig rten gang gi skabs su yang le lo ni rang nyid kyi rkang pa 'then mkhan dang yar rgyas mi 'do ba'i gegs che do/sa de yin na 'di la nges par gzab dbo sa/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ le 'o/ can la chu yang ring / dang /blo ldan pā stor gyis 'a car+shar na yang / /le lo can la ma lnga na 5wa dka'/ /rna ba thog mar skyes na yang / /rwa rtse mtho ba ma mthong ngam/ /zhes gsungs so//de ltar sa bcad dang po bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa 'di'i nang gleng gzhi lo rgyus kyi sgo nas brda sprod 'phel rim gyi lnga sprod dang / yig gzugs kyi dbang du byas pa'i snga dar dang / bar dar/ phyi dar/ dgag bzhag mthil phyin pa'i sgo nas thun shā snang gi rig gnas 〈snan tan tshang ma'i rtsa bar 'gyur tshul bshad pa dang / de nyid kyi 〈snas bsam la shin tu gces da spro rwas tshul/ yi ge'i byed 'od dang brda spro da kyi byed po gcig yin min thad ro stonas ga ror+sha da gsal bshad/
bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba brjod pa/ 77sum rtags kyi rtsa ba dang yi ge'i 47ra ba'i rtsa ba rnam gnyis dbar mthun dang mi mthun gyi mchan 'bosnod byed pa/ snga 'grel dang phyi 'grel gyi dpe lnga bstan rtsis dang sbyar te bkod pa/ yi ge'i byed po thon mi'i rnam thar rgan rabs ngag rgyun/klog slob da〈snan gyi 〈snad yig 'khrid thabs bcas 'dir bto da pa re zhig mjug bsdus pa lags 〈r+sha// //
rab byed gnyis pa/sum rtags kyis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang stong thub/9lha sum rtags gnyis ni lnga da kyi brda sprod rig pa'i rtsa ba'i gzhung de yin cing /brda sprod kyi gzhung ni rjod byed kyi ngag gi sgyu rtsal de nyid rang bzhin lhan skyes skad kyi gshis gar ji ltar gnas pa gtan la phab pa'i gzhung der bsnyu da da spro sa/des na brda sprod pa'i gzhung la brten nas rjod byed kyi ngag don dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / rjod byed kyi ngag la brten nas brjod bya'i don gang zhig don dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin/ skad yig gi byed las ni brjod bya'i don ma nor bar rjod cabyed kyi ngag la brten nas pha 1ril 'o/sa 'khrul med du spro nus pa ba smra sna rgyu de yin/brjod bya don de rjod byed kyi ngag la brten pa dang / rjod byed kyi ngag de yang brda sprod pa'i spro gas la brten nas brgyud da spro sa pas na 1rid byed dag pa'i rgyu de brda 〈snad la bzhag 〉stog/des na brda sprod rig pas dgos mkho cha tshang skong thub min ni de nyid la brten nas snyung da byed rnam dag cig sgrub nus dang mi nus la rag las shing /rjod byed kyi ngag de yis rang gi dbo sa mkho cha tshang ba zhig spradang thub min ni de nyid la brten nas brje dod bya rnam par dag la cha tshang ba zhig sgrub nus dang mi nus la bzhag da spro sa/ des na sum rtags la brten nas sdus da byed kyi ngag gang
80bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥzhig gis bsgyurd bya'i 5wan gang zhig cha tshang ba gtan la dbab thub na sum rtags de brda sprod rig pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang slong thub par ngos 'dzin byed dgos/de gas sgyu khag ste sum rtags la brten nas rjod byed kyi ngag gang zhig gis brjod bya'i 5 sten gang zhig nyi tshe ba gas gtan la dbab thub kyi mi 'dug na sum rtags kyis brda sprod rig pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang stong mi thub par ngos 'dzin byed dgos/ rang re'i sum rtags la brten nas 'jig rten nyer spyod kyi dgos mkho tsam ma zad 'jig rten las 'das dang ma 'das pa'i rnam gzhag ches shin tu phra ba rnams kyang gtan la dbab thub kyi 5wad na sum rtags kyis lnga da kyi brda spro snad pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang slong thub min gyi rnam rtog skyon 53 rigs don mthun ye nas nyamin pa da ga pā da nga sdugs nges shes 'a5wang thub nges yin//dper na lung sde stod gsum ni rjod byed kyi ngag zhig la bzhag chog cing /de yi bstan don lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum ni brjod bya'i don der ngos 'dzin pa yin/ lnga da yig gtan la phab pa'i rjes su byung ba'i 17da skad du bzhugs pa'i lung sde stod gsum gyi gsung rab rnams da lta nga rang tsho'i dpe mdzod khang rnams su bzhugs par gsol ba de rnams yin cing / sde stod de dag gis brjod bya'i bslab gsum 'khrul med bstan pa'i lag rjes su bod gangs can gyi ldongs su mkhas grub zam ma chad pa byung ba yin/ lugs lde ga gi dbang du byas na/brjod bya bslab gsum phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas rjod byed lung sde stod gsum rnam dag tu grub cing / rjod byed yang dag pa la brten nas skad yig phun sum 49gas par grub 'o// /skad yig phun sum 49gas pa la brten nas de yi brda spro da phun sum chon gas pa las kyis grub/ der brten sum rtags kyis 1khud kyi brda
sum rtags kyis dgos mkho cha tshang skyong thub/ 81sprod rig pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang (wang thub pa yin/ 'bras dang dha lis bkres pa med par ba ro sna thub bshad par bag leb ci phyir za gi 5wad ces dri ba mi gnang bar zhu//'o na nga tshos sum rtags gnyis gcig pur slob sbyong byas te skad yig gi nus pa yongs su sgyu dgas nus sam zer na/ 'di yi spro lnga na ni sum rtags gnyis gcig pur sprarwa ba sbyong byas pas skad yig gi nus pa yodangs su rdzogs pa'i go dorwa na gtan nas min/ 'dir bshad pa'i dmigs yul ni sum rtags gnyis ga brten nas ro da kyi skad yig gi gshis ka ji ltar yin pa shes pa dang /de la brten nas rjod byed rnam dag cig sgrub ste brjod bya'i don phyin ci ma log pa gtan la dbab thub kyi sku da pa'i sgrub byed tsam bto snad pa las chor+shas kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i 'dod chung chog shes lta bu 'dir yang slob dgos pa'i don min pa mkhyen par ma〈(da// gar nas rang re'i ston pas mi lo nyis stong drug brgya gnyis kyi sngon lor bden bzhi'i phyur+shas 'a〈snar blta dor nas 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i go don de chos bshad tsam min zhing / 'di ni dngos po'i gnas stangs gang yin gsal bshad byed pa'i bden pa chen kro zhig yin/ nga coms rang gi skad yig 'di la snga phyi bar gsum du 'gyur ba song yod pa khas len dgos shing /de'i dbang gis bod kyi brda sprod la yang mngon dang mi mngon sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gyur ba 5wang 5wad pa dorwa na gyis grub/ chor+shas rgyal skabs nas kyang da spro sa mkho'i dbang gis skad dang 'gyur la bkas bcad byung ba las kyang 'di slor nga tshos khas len byed thub/ bkas bcad kyi go don yang ye shes rab gsal gyis/
82bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥde la bkas bcad rim par byung ba ni bod yig 'di skad dang ye mi mthun pas mthun par ba ther+shas pa min par 1—ra je yangs dang stabs je bde brda rnams cha 'a〈rig med par ya ma zung du mi gyes shing kun mthun go don yod pa sogs la dgongs par sems te/ dper na yul lung khag la lar myi dang smyung lta bu gsar bcad ma byung ba'i sngon skad dang mthun yang da lta mi dang ming du ba༄was pa yin//1zhes gsal/ des na nga 49sa sum rtags gnyis kyi snga phyi'i 'grel pa gang mang mang la slo rwa ba sbyo khang byas te rtsa ba'i gzhung nang mngon dang mi mngon pa ji snyed la tshe/sa bsam gyis spro 'do gas legs par de nges pa'i ste nga du skad yig gi sgyu rtsal la mkho ba'i legs bshad rnams gnas dus dang 'gyur ba'i dbang gis byung ba rnams kha ston dang dus bstun gyis phun sum je tshogs su gtong dgos/'on kyang 'di yi go don sum rtags gnyis kyis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i dgos mkho cha tshang spradang mi thub pa'i spro / khu na yang gtan nas min/ gang zhig gi da spro sa mkho spradang thub min gyi don ni mthun rkyen gang zhig yod med la 'jog mi rung zhing / de yi spro ( na ni mthun rkyen gang zhig da spro sa pa de sku/da med la 'phra ga gi/rang la dgos mkho med tshe de nyid med kyang cha ma tshang ba dang zhan char brtsi mi rung / dper na gna' ro'i rgyal po rnams la gam pu'i ṭar gyi mthun rkyen med kyang de nyid med pa de dag gi da spro sa mkho cha mi tshang bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin pā ste//mthun rkyen gang zhig rang nyid la shin tu mkho yang de nyid med tshe zhan char 'gyur zhing / des na sum rtags gnyis ni brgya phrag bdun pa'i nang brtsams par grags pa'i bstan ba༄was shig yin zhing / de dang de'i da spro sa
sum rtags kyis da spro gis mkho cha tshang spradang thub/ 83mkho yang de'i dus kyi spyi don gas kyi da spro sa mkho dang skad kyi gshis gar zhib 'jug 'bur du thon pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba zhig yin pa gas phyi rabs pa rnams kyis zhan char brtsir rung ba'i bstan bcos shig ga la yin/sum rtags gnyis kyi nang dngos su ma 'khod pa'i phrad dzi snyed cig yod cing /de dag phyi rabs pa'i brda sprod smra ba rnams kyis mi nyams spro nga spel dang nyams pa sor chud du dgongs te dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyi dgos mkho'i rjes su 'brangs she kha skong thub na zhanas skabs thams cad du sum rtagasaXspyo gzhung de dgos mkho dang ldan par 'gyur/ rang re'i sum rtags kyi gzhung 'di ni chos kyi skad yig gcig pu'i ched du min la/ 'di ni bod kyi khyon yongs su khyab pa'i thun mong spyi tshogs kyi skad yig gi brda spro rwad kyi cad khrims lta bu yin//sog po lta bu la mtshon na sum rtags dang mthun pa'i bod kyi skad yig de chos skad 'ba' zhig tu zad cing / rang gi skad ni bod yig nang 'bri dgos don med la/ 'bri thub kyi'ang med nges/ 'on kyang deng sang 'brug dang 'bras ldongs lta bur mtshon na bod kyi skad yig de chos skad kho nar brtsis te rgyun spyod kyi skad de kha skad kho nar gzhi bcol te spe la bzhin yod rung /'byung 'gyur khong rnams la skad yig dang 'brel ba'i dka' ngal de ri lug pa thag pas mi 'dum pa'i dpe ltar 'gyur nyen 5wad/ la dwags dang shārwa na pa rnams kyis de dag las bslab bya blangs te yig 'bri byed skabs kha skad (wa nar gzhi ma ba༄wal bar gal 'gangs che sar kha snyad na bcug ste kha skad dang chor+shas skad gnyis ka skad yig gcig rang du lnga sa 'dzin gnang nas srung skyo khab byas pa de tan tan skad yig srung skyo ba thad byas rjes chen lnga bzhag par sems bzhin sku/da/
84bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbod pa rnams la ni sngar nas da bar brda sprod dang mthun pa'i bris ma gang zhig la yang stod mnga' ris nas smad rgya'i mchod rten dkar po bar dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i lo rgyus med/ 'di yang sum rtags gnyis kyis bod kyi brda sprod rig gnas kyi dgos mkho cha tshang slong thub pa'i gsal bshad cig tu 'gyur ba'o//thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje che ba bdag cag gi sto gin pa bka' drin can gyis 'bo ba sems can rnams sdug bsngal mtha' dag las spro la phyir gdug bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par grub mtha' bzhi dang theg pa gsum ci rigs kyi lha nas chos tshul ji snye da cig bka' stsal ba la brten nas skyes bu dam pa grangs kyis mi chor+sha da pa zhig ma skyong na par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang /9grub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse ro/ra sku na pa/ lam sna 'dren pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen snga nas da bar zam ma chad par byon dang 'byon par 'gyur ba la the mi tshom zhing /'di dag gis gang zhig 'chad par 'dod pa de ni chos tshul de dag gis mngon mtho nges legs kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa dang / ma mthar yang mi tshe bzang mthar 'a spu ta la ba la gdams ngag tshang la ma sbya stor ba yin zhes pa 'di yin//snyamun kyang 'ga' zhig gis nga don 'chom gnas pa yin/ khu sa kyis 'chom gnas pa la de tsam da spro sa mkho sgrub mi nus/ des na co〉sa tshul de dag spyi don gas yar rgyas 4kyi gegs su smra ba rnams la 5)na mthun gyi gsal bshad cig da torwa so kyang skabs dang ma 'brel ba'i skyo khan du 'bo bar 5wags nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par byed/de dag gi zhi phugs kyi mngon 'dod ni tshan rig la brten nas spyi tshogs 'tsho nus pa de rtsal du 'don phyir yin par sems/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos snga phyi bar gsum du phyi nang mkhas pa brgya phrag brgal bar ba spro( gleng dang 'brel
