398bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥrtsol gcig par 'dod pa dang / nga ma 'a gsum sgra rtsol gcig par 'dod pa dang /na ra la gsum sgra rtsol gcig par 'dod pa de ltar min te/ rtsab las/ pho gsum shā sna gnyis ma ning gsum/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jug /drag pa gsum nyid nang phrad dam/ /gal te zhan pa nang phrad na/ de la'ang nang gi cha shas kyis//de yang drag zhan gnyis su dbye/ /ma ning gsum du gang gtogs pa/ /drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang phrad gyur na/ /de ni gnyis ka can du 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang ma phrad na//gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro / /des na 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /mtshan nya med dag dang gsum du 'dod/ /de zhi sgra yi 'jug tshul lo/ /zhes gsal lo//de bzhin 'di yi mdor bstan skabs su/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po la/ /pho mo ma zhing gsum du dbye/ /pho la skyes bu rab 'bring gsum/ /mo la mo dang shin tu mo//ma ning 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /mtshan med dag dang gsum du 'dod//ces gsal 'ong//snyu / na ga da ba sa bzhi gar pho yig ces rtags gcig tu 'phra tshun da torwa sa pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam zhe na/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge rnams sgra nyal drag zhan bar ma'i sde tshan gsum du phye ba na ga da ba sa bzhi drag pa'i sde tshan du gdog kas pa'i 〈 sna nas 〉skyor bzhag pa yin/ de bzhin snang dang shin tu snang la yang mtshungs pa yin//rjes 'jug bcu yi bye brag gam nang gses kyi rtags brgyad nyi lnga sa 'dzin ni/pho la nang gses kyi drag zhan bar ma gsum du phye ba ni skyes bu rab dang / 'bring /tha ma bcas yin/ de la dang po skyes bu rab ni sngon 'jug yod med dang / ming gzhi gang yin la ltos med kyis rjes 'jug ga yang 'jug can rnams yin/ dper
dbyangs gsal sngon rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 399na rigs dang brtags lta bu yin/ skyes bu 'bring ni sngon 'jug yod med dang /ming gzhi gang yin la ltos med kyis rjes 'jug ba yang 'jug can rnams yin/dper na rabs dang chabs lta bu yin/ skyes bu tha ma ni sngon 'jug yod med dang /ming gzhi gang yin la lto snas med kyis rjes 'jug ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang /rjes 'jug da sa'i mtha' can rnams yin/ dper na rig dang brtag /rab dang chab/ bod dang dad/ sras dang rgyas lta bu yin no//ro sna la nang gses kyi drag zhan gnyis su phye ba ni shārware ma ro/ tsam dang / shin tu mo bcas yin/ dang po mo tsam ni/ sngon 'jug yod med dang / ming gzhi gang yin la ltos med kyis rjes 'jug nga ma yang 'jug can rnams yin/ dper na/gangs dang dwangs/ khams dang gtams lta bu yin/ gnyis pa shin tu mo ni/sngo rwan 'jug sku da med dang / ming gzhi gang yin la lto snas med kyis nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang / 'a mtha' rten thob pa rnams yin/ dper na/ gang dang gang /kham dang gtam/ mkha' dang mtha' lta ༄ ///bar ma ma ning na ra la gsum la nang gses kyi sde tshan gsum du phye ba ni mtshan med ma zhing dang / mtshan gnyis ma zhing / 'gyur ba ma zhing bcas yin/gong du bshad pa'i pho dang mo'i nang gses kyi dbye ba ni rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug nang 'phrad 5wad med tsam gyis khyad par phye ba ma gtor+sha gas ming gzhi gang yin la lta sa med yin na yang / 'dir ma zhing gi skabs su ni de gas 〈snag ste ma ning gi yi ge rnams ming gzhi'i yi ge dang / rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug nang 'phrad yod med la yang ltos pa yin/ 'on kyang sngon 'jug gang yin dang /5wad med la mi lta sa pa yin//
400bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥde yang / dang po mtshan med ma zhing ni/ sngon 'jug yod med ji ltar yang /ming gzhi ma zhing la rjes 'jug ma zhing phrad pa tsam las yang 'jug med pa rnams yin/ dper na/ tshan dang mtshan/ thar dang 'char/ phal dang 'phel lta bu'o//gnyis pa mtshan gnyis ma ning ni/ sngo rwan 'jug sku da med ji ltar yang / ming gzhi mo yig la rjes 'jug ma zhing zhugs shing / yang 'jug dang bcas pa rnams yin/dper na/ yind/ 'dzind/ sgyur/ bsgyurd/ rold/ 'jald lta bu'o//gsum pa 'gyur ba ma zhing la nang gses kyis phye na drag dang 'phrad pas drag par 'gyur ba dang / zhan dang 'phrad pas zhan par 'gyur ba bcas gnyis sku/da pa gas dang po drag 'phrad ni/ rjes 'jug ma ning la sngon 'jug yod med ji ltar yang /smang gzhi pho yig mthar yang 'jug sku da med gang rung rnams dang / ming gzhi ma zhing mthar yang 'jug sku da pa rnams 'gyur ba ma zhing sga drag phrad yin/ dper na/skor dang bskor/ skord dang bskord/ phyind dang mkhyend/ thard dang 'phard/phald dang 'pheld lta bu'o/ /'di rnams ni 'gyur ba ma zhing gi drag dang 'phrad pas drag 'phrad ces pa rnams yin/ gnyis pa 'gyur ba ma zhing gi zhan 'phrad ni/rjes 'jug ma ning la sngon 'jug yod med ji ltar yang / ming gzhi mo yig gi mthar yang 'jug med pa rnams yin/ dper na/ dan dang bden/ gar dang 'gar/ngal dang mngal lta bu yin no//sprodang gsal si tu'i rab dbye de dag la da dung zhib 'jug byas te rgyas bshad bkod na drag po skor dgu dang / zhan pa skor drug gi dper brjod tshul bzhin 'jog thub/ de yang / rab kyi rab ni ming gzhi pho yig gi rjes su skyes bu rab kyi dper brjod dgos pa dper na btags dang / rab kyi 'bring ni ming gzhi
dbyangs gsal sngo na rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 401ma ning gi rjes su skyes bu rab kyi dper brjod dgos shing dper na chags dang /rab kyi tha ma ni ming gzhi mo yi rjes su skyes bu rab kyi dper brjod dgos shing dper na 'jigs lta bu ste rab kyi skor gsum mo//de bzhin 'bring gi rab ni ming gzhi 'od yig gi rjes su skyes bu 'bring gi dper brjod dgos shing dper na skabs dang / 'bring gi 'bring ni ma ning gi rjes su skyes bu 'bring gi dper brjod dgos shing dper na/ chabs dang /'bring gi tha ma ni ming gzhi mo yig gi rjes su skyes bu 'bring gi dper brjod dgos shing dper na 'debs lta bu ste 'bring gi skor gsum mo//de bzhin tha ma'i rab ni ming gzhi nyo yig gi rjes su skyes bu tha ma'i dper ba༄wad da spro sa shing dper na/ bkag /bcad/ btab/ btsas dang / tha ma'i 'bring ni ming gzhi ma zhing gi rjes su skyes bu tha ma'i dper brjod dgos shing dper na/khag /chad/ khab/ khas dang / tha ma'i tha ma ni ming gzhi sna/ yig gi rjes su skyes bu tha ma'i dper brjod dgos shing dper na/ dgag /bod/ gab/ sras lta bu ste/tha ma'i skor gsum ste drag po dgu slor 'di ltar du bshad na tha snyad pra nyi las g.yar yang dper brjod si tu'i lugs dang rjes su mthun pa yin//de bzhin zhan pa lta dor drug la ma lnga rdon na ro/ rab ni ming gzhi 14 yig gi rjes su sna/ tsam gyi dper brjod dgos shing dper na bskangs/ bskams/ mo 'bring ni ming gzhi ma ning gi rjes su mo tsam gyi dper brjod da spro sa shing dper na 'khrungs khams dang / shā/ tha ma ni ming gzhi snang yig gi rjes su sna sna tsam gyi dper bsgyurd da spro sa shing dper na gangs dang byams lta bu ste shā sna tsam phru dor gsum/ de bzhin shin tu mo'i rab ni ming gzhi 'od yig gi rjes su shin tu mo'i dper brjod dgos shing dper na/
402bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbkang / skam/ bka' dang / shin tu mo'i 'bring ni ming gzhi ma ning gi rjes su shin tu mo'i dper brjod dgos shing dper na/ chang / kham/ mkha' dang / shin tu mo'i tha ma ni ming gzhi mo yig gi rjes su shin tu mo'i dper brjod da spro sa shing dper na/gang / sgam/ 'ga' lta bu ste shin tu mo'i skor gsum mo/ /mo tsam skor gsum dang shin tu mo'i phru nor gsum ni rjes 'jug sna/ yig yin pa/ zhan pa yin pa'i cha nas zhan pa drug skor du bshad pa lags so/ /rab dbye 'di dag dper brjod dang bcas pa ni si tu'i rjes 'brang rnams la gsar bshad dang legs bshad gnyis ka yin pa bdag slo khums/ 'di thad 'gos kyi bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/nya kho bos bltas na rjes 'jug ma ning na ra la gsum ming gzhi'i rtags las sgra gdangs la khyad par 'a spro na 'o/ ga da ba sa bzhi dang sna/ nga ma 'a gsum yang ming gzhi'i rtags las sgra gdangs la khyad par 'do/ da spro/sa pa lta bu 'dug pas/ des na skyes bu rab ni ming gzhi pho'i rjes su yang 'jug yod med ji ltar rung rjes 'jug pho bzhi zhugs pa dang /(dper na/bkag lcags/ btab/ skabs/ skad/ bkas/) skyes bu 'bring zhi ming gzhi ma zhing la rjes 'jug pho bzhi zhugs pa yang 'jug yod med gnyis ka dang /(dper na/chag chags/ chab/ chabs/ chad/ chos/) skyes bu mtha' ma ni ming gzhi mo nyi shu la rjes 'jug pho bzhi zhugs pa yang 'jug yod med gnyis gar 'a〉stod (dper na/ 'gag bsngags/ sgab/ sdebs/ bod/ 'gos/ sras/) de bzhin shā/ gnyis las 〈 sna tsam ni ming gzhi pho'i rjes su nga ma 'a gsum yang 'jug sku dod med gnyis ka dang /(dper na/ bkang / bskyangs/ skam/ brkams/bka'/) shin tu mo ni ming gzhi ma zhing dang mo'i rjes su nga ma 'a gsum
dbyangs gsal sngon rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 403yang 'jug yod med ji ltar yang rung ba shin tu mor 'dod cing /(dper na/ khang / 'khrungs/ kham/ khams/ mkha'/ bang / 'bangs/ sgam/ byams/ 'ga'/)ma ning gsum ni si tu ltar 'dod pa yin/19 zhes gsal/3don gyi tshul ji ltar 'jug pa bshad pa/lha don gyi tshul ji ltar 'jug pa la snga phyi gnyis las dang spro ni/ 'di skabs bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi bshad pa byed stangs la bltas na ci phyir 'jug pa'i gzhung du dgod par 'os kyang de nyid gtso bo sngon 'jug gi nus pa la ltos dgos par brten gong du bshad zin par sems dgos/ rtsab las/ don ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /snga ma gang ltar gyur pa dang / /phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'o//snga ma sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir bstan snga ma ni ming gzhi gang la sbyar ba'i rjes 'jug gi yi ge de la zer ba yin/ rjes 'jug la snga ma zer da1—sa pa'i rgyu mtshan ni des drangs pa'i ming mtha' la phyi ma dang /de la 〈snas te rjes 'jug de snga mar grub pas na snga ma zhes zer ba yin//kha cig gis rjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa'i ming rangs 11ra snga ma zer ba 'dug kyang de ni gzhan dang gzhan gyi lugs yin pa las rang lugs su mi bzhed rong / 1 gang lags she na/ 'dir bstan dorwa na gyi 'jug tshul bshad pa na snga ma rjes 'jug de yi nus pa la brten nas ming rangs 'od de bdag gzhan dus gsum gang yin pa dang / ming mtha' ji ltar 'dren tshul bshad pa ma gtorwa kas ming rangs spro nyid bdag gzhan dus gsum dang / ming rangs po de yis ming mtha' 'dren
404bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥtshul ma bshad pa'i phyir/ /snga ma rjes 'jug gis bdag gzhan dus gsum ston stangs ni gtso bo sngo don 'jug gi nus pa dang bstun nas bshad dgos pa yin/de'i go don ni bya tshig tsheg bar gcig gi nang sngon rjes gnyi ga yod na rjes 'jug las sngon 'jug gtso ba byas te sngon 'jug des bdag gzhan gang zhig ston rung rjes 'jug des kyang de nyid las gzhan pa zhig ston pa med/ bya tshig tsheg bar gcig tu sngon 'jug med na ni rjes 'jug de'i nus pas yin pa spros mi dgos/dper na/ byas lta bu 'das tshig yin pa rjes 'jug sa nyid kyis ston pa yin/rtags 'jug gi dbo gings 'grel ke ta ga'i gan ma snyu pyod ces/ bya ba na/ phyi ma rjes 'jug gam mtha' des ming mtha' la sod gas pa gzhan 'dren tshul ni/nyarjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa'i ming der go na cung zad rtog pa rtsing ba'i bshad par 'gyur zhing / de las phyi ma de rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug gang rung la go ba len na rigs par sems so/ /zhes bkod 'dug /'on kyang phyi ma 'di nyid ming mtha' phyi ma min cing snga ma yin/ des na rtsa bar bstan pa'i snga ma gang ltar gyur pa'i snga ma dang / phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'i phyi ma gnyis ka rjes 'jug nyid la spro4 da spro sa pa yin/ de yang si tu'i zhal lung las/snga ma rjes 'jug nyid gang la zhugs shing gnas pa'i ming de'i don gang ltar te ji lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma rjes 'jug gam mtha' des ming mtha' la sogs pa 'dren tshul gyis don gang ltar 'gyur bsnyu / //20zhes gsal/ 'di ni skabs 'dir bstan don gyi 'jug tshul las mdor bstan rtsaba dang sbyar te legs par smras pa yin/ 'on kyang phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba 'chad
dbyangs gsal sngon rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 405pa nyid la yang mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis su phye ba'i mdor bstan gyi rtsab/phyi ma dag gi 'dren tshul ni/ /zhes pa'i phyi ma ni 'grel chen las phyi ma ming mtha' dang rnam dbye sogs kyi thob thang gi don ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul ni snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang phyi ma'i brjod bya dag la ci rigs par ltos pa'i sgo nas 'dren pa'i phyir/ de'i tshul slos pa zhi zhes mdor bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsal/ des na mdor bstan snga ma'i skabs su phyi ma de rjes 'jug gam 'dren byed la bshad pa dang /mdor bstan phyi ma ste rgyas bshad kyi mdor bstan skabs phyi ma de ming mtha' ste 'dren bya la go bar bshad pa de rigs pa smra ba'i lugs dang mi 'gal lam snyam mo//rang gis go ba'i dbang du byas na ni rje si tur rtsab nyams pa zhig phyag tu son pa min nam snyam/ phyi ma dag gi 'dren tshul ni/ /zhes pa de rtsab ngo mar/ phyi ma dag gis 'dren tshul ni/ /zhes pa i ldan gi sgrar sa mtha' 5wad pa zhig da spro sa par sems so de ltar byung na mdor bstan rgyas bshad 'grel tshul gcig tu mtshungs par bdag nyid sems so/ /lhag par phyi ma zhes pa de mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis ga'i skabs su rjes 'jug la go na go ba bzang ba'i rgyu mtshan ngo ma ni phyi ma'i rgyas bshad kyi cas ba las/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang / /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang / /zhes sogs gsal ba'i phyir/ 'di skabs kyi 'grel tshul yang 'di ltar da spro sa te/ phyi ma ming mtha' snga ma ste rjes 'jug pho yis ming mtha' phyi ma ming gzhi'i pho yig drang bar bya zhes 〈snags kyi ro snon yin/ dka' 'grel 1snan mi bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs su 'di skabs bra si gnyis mi'i rtsa bar med pa'i rtsa ba gsar pa/'ong yis tho ni ming mtha' drang / /mo yis mo ni ming mtha' drang / /ma zhing gis ni
406bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥma ning ngo / /zhes ched du mngags nas 'don pa bsgyur pa yin na ni rtsal du bton nas bshad dgos kyang de ltar bshad pa mi snang na dpyad par bya ba'i gnas su gyur/rgyu mtshan gang lags she na/ ming mtha' 'dren tshul bshad pa'i skabs su ming mtha' snga mas phyi ma 'dren dbo dos pa las ming mtha' phyi mas ming mtha' phyi ma gzhan zhig 'dren pa gang du'ang ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ lhag par mdor bstan rtsa bas bstan pa'i ming mtha' snga phyi gnyis ka rjes 'jug la ma bzhag pa'i dbang du btang na de yis ming mtha' phyi ma gzhan de ji ltar 'dren nam/ming mtha' snga ma zhig med par smra na ni phyi ma yang mi rung bar 'gyur te phan tshun ltos grub kyis snga phyi grub pa gang zhig snga ma med pa'i phyir/ snga ma de ming gzhir 'i jog dgos par sems na ni/ de yang mi rigs te ming mtha' 'dren pa'i skabs/pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drangs/ /zhes sku/gas kyi lhum do tsheg khyim gang zhig gi rjes 'jug la go ba ma gtogs ming gzhi la mi go ba'i phyir//4rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde'i skor bshad pa/lta 'di ni rtags 'jug nas bshad pa'i brda sprod kyi gnad don gal chen zhig yin/rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde'i rigs pa 'di la brten nas sum cu pa nas bshad pa'i rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad rnams kyi sgra'i sbyor tshul gyi rgyu mtshan legs par rtogs thub/ de bzhin ming mtha' 'dren pa'i skabs su yang ka kha ga gsum las gang zhig dang / pa ba gnyis las gang zhig 'bri da spro sa pa'i
dbyangs gsal sngo na rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 407gnad kyang legs bshad 'di yi go ba gting zab cig ma rnyed na shes par dka'/'dir bstan rtags mtshungs zhes pa ni nges par du 'bod dgos pa'i tsheg khyim gnyis can las gong ma'i rjes 'jug gam yang 'jug gi rtags dang /'og ma'i ming gzhi'i rtags/ yang na tsheg khyim gcig dang de'i rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad gnyis las gong ma'i rjes 'jug gi rtags dang / 'og ma'i rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad de'i rtags gang yin pa la dpyad pa yin/ gong 'og gnyis rtags gcig pa yin na rtags mtshungs dang / gal te spro nga snyung ga gnyis rtags gcig pa min na rtags mi mtshungs pa yin/ bsdud da bde'i spro do sten ni spro snang 'og gi rtags mtshungs min la ma ltos par 'bod bde po yod na brjod bde yin/brjod bde 'di'i khongs su rtags mtshungs yin min ci rigs yod kyang rtags mtshungs min pa rnams la ba〈snad bde dang rtags mtshungs yin pa rnams la rtags mtshungs zer ba yin/ kha cig gis brjod bde khas blang du mi 'dod pa dang /kha cig gis bsnyu da bde la rtags mtshungs med pa dang / kha cig gis bsnyu da bde'i go don du ngag nas brjod bde spro yod pa tsam las ming mtha' 'dren tshul la ma sbya bsam mi ga lta slong ba bcas ni spo rwa ka torwa ka kho nar zad/ rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde gnyis ka khas blang du rung ste rtsab las/ phyi ma dag gi 'dren tshul ni//pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang / /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang / /ma ning gis ma zhing ngo / /ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis ni/ /de nyid rang gi sgra mthun pa'i//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir//rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad rnams ni rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde ci rigs kyi sgo nas 'jug pa yin/ la don lta bu'i sgra'i sbyor tshul la mtshon na ga
408bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥba da drag bcas su tu sgra to ba pa zhi 'o/ yis 'o/ yig drangs pas rtags mtshungs dang /de bzhin nga ma gnyis kyi rjes su du sgra dang / 'a mtha' rten yod med gang rung gi rjes su ra ru'i sgra thob pa bcas ni mo yis ro sna yig drangs pas rtags mtshungs yin/ 'on kyang da mthar du sgra dang / na ra la gsum gyi mthar du sgra/ de bzhin sa mthar su sgra lnga gib pa bcas ni rim bzhin 'o/ yis 〈sna yig dang ma ning gis ro/ yig/pho yis mo yig drangs pas brjod bde yin/ de bzhin i ldan gyi sgra'i sbyor tshul ni 1 rjes 'jug da ba sa'i rjes su kyi sgra dang / ma yi rjes su gyi sgra/ nga'i rjes su gi dang / 'a mtha' rten 5wad med kyi rjes su 'i dang yi bcas ni rtags mtshungs yin/rjes 'jug ma zhing na ra la gsum gyi rjes su gyi sgra snyu ba pa ni ba༄wad bde yin/ gang lags she na/ i ldan gyi nang du ming gzhi ma zhing las grub pa'i phrad med pas yin/'di dag gis mchon na par byas te lhag ma rnams shes par bya'o / //stod na dpyid dbyar dgun gyi rjes su rang gi ming mthar ka kha ga gsum nas gang rung zhig bris kyang brjod bde yod par brten ches mi rigs pa med mod/'on kyang ming mtha' 'dren pa'i skabs su rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde gnyis ka 5wad na rtags mtshungs 'bri da spro sa pa de rang re'i brda spro da pa'i spyi 5wal yin/des na stodzin kha dang / dpyid ka /dbyar kha/ dgun kha zhes 'bri da〈stos pa yin/ 'di yi rgyu mtshan lnga ri ma ni gang du rtags mtshungs da spro sa sa der rtags mtshungs bris sku rwad na der nges par brjod bde yod la/ 'on kyang gang du brjod bde yod pa der rtags mtshungs nges par yod pa'i bshad pa byed du med/ des na dpyid ka lta bu la mtshon na/dpyid kha dang dpyid ga /dpyid ka bcas gsum gar brjod bde 5wad pa mtshungs kyang /dpyid ka zhes pa 'dir brjod bde yod par ma zad rtags mtshungs 'phar ma yod par
dbyangs gsal sngo rwan rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 409brten 'di nyid la rtags mtshungs zhes ma gdo/gas bsnyu da bde zhes mi zer/ snyung na kyang brjod bde med pa'i don ni gtan nas min no/ /'di thad smra sgo'i lde mig tu/de ltar na'ang 'dir sgra rig par shin tu gal che ba'i gnas dper na 〈〈rtags 'jug〉〉 gi gzhung du ming mtha' 'dren tshul la rtags mtshungs dang ba1rid bde 'dren tshul gang yin gyi rnam gzhag /de bzhin du yi ge'i byed rtsol dang skye gnas kyi lkor/ gzhan yang legs sbyar gyi brda spro dod las dpe blangs pa'i tshig sdud kyi rnam gzhag la ro/gas pa rnams ni sngon gyi brda sprod kyi gzhung du bshad pa mdzad srol yod na'ang bod yig 'bri slog gi rtsal 'thob pa'i phyir brda sprod sbyong ba la gnad 'di dag de tsam nye bar mi mkho bas de rnams la 'dir bshad pa mi da spro/sa par byas 5wad pa bcas mkhyen 'tshal 1 21rtsozhes gsal 'dug kyang rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde'i rnam gzhag ni bod skad rang gi thun ro/nga ma yin pa'i rang gshis la sku da pa'i rnam gzhag gal chen zhig yin cing / 'di skor nyid kyi smra sgo'i lde mig tu ma bkod kyang chog la/'on kyang bod kyi brda sprod kyi rnam gzhag nang legs sbyar brda sprod las dpe blangs pa'i tshig sdud kyi rnam gzhag bzhin bod kyi brda spro rwad du nye bar mi mkho bar bshad pa 'di ni don la mi gnas pa'i 'grel brjod cig lags/ lhag par phrad dang rnam dbye ming mtha'i sbyor tshul yongs rdzogs rtags mtshungs dang brjod bde gang rung la brten pa zhig yin par the don ma med/ skye gnas kyi slor 'di yang 'bri rtsal la de tsam mi mkhong ba bden yang skru rwa ka la ma mārgan na yul mi zhig la rang nyid kyi skad yig
410bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥyin pa rgyu mtshan du byas te ched du ma bslabs kyang rang bzhin gyis shes thub pa bden yang / deng sga dus su ni bod phrug mi nyung ba zhig nas nga dang rnga/ ca dang tsa/cha dang tsha/ na dang sna/ ma dang sma/ sa dang za/ sha dang zha bcas kyi thad kyang dka' ngal 'phrad pa 'di dag bsnyon du med/ der brten gal chen gal chung du bzung ba dang gal chung gal chen du bzung ba'i rnam rtog ni legs par ma bshad do//5rjes 'jug gi ci phyir 'jug pa bshad pa/ma ༈ rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa gang gi phyir zhugs pa de la rjes 'jug gi ci phyir 'jug pa zer ba yin/ spyir btang rjes 'jug gi don gyi tshul ji ltar 'jug pa'i skabs su rjes 'jug gi dbo sa pa bshad pa yin na'ang / 'dir dmigs bsal rjes 'jug gi ci phyir 'jug pa bshad pa zhes sa bcad logs su bkod pa ni rjes 'jug gi yi ge rnams ming gcig grub pa la yang med thabs med pa ston pa'i ched du yin/ de yang mab las/ ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na//yi ge'i kho/ngas nas ming dbyung ste/ /ming gi kho ngas nas tshig phyung nas/ /tshig gis na na rnams storwa na par byed/ /mo yi yi ge med pa na/ /pho yig blta khad pa med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang / /'jug par bcas pa med par ni//ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /ming tshig gsal bar med na ni/ /〈snan rnams brjod par mi 'gyur dod/ /zhes dang / de bzhin sum cu pa'i rtsab las kyang / rdzon 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin la//
dbyangs gsal skru don rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 411nyis 'brel 5wad dam sum 'brel 5wad/ /ā li bzhi las gang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bcu 'o/ ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyod ra ba 5wad mi srid/ /ces gsal ba ltar ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs ni dbyangs gsal 'dus pa las grub cing / dper na/ nga dang kha lta bu'o//'on kyang de dag la rjes 'jug bcu po gang rung zhig ma zhugs na gong gsal nga zhes pa de yis nga dang khyod ces pa'i nga'i don ston mi thub cing / de bzhin spro nga gsal kha zhes pa des kyang kha mig gnyis su phye ba'i kha yi 〈snan 〈snan mi thub/des na spro nga gsal gsal byed nga la rjes 'jug 'a yig zhugs pa na nga dang 97da kyi nga yi ro na lha na/ de bzhin 〈snang gsal gsal byed kha la rjes 'jug 'a zhugs pa na kha mig gnyis su phye ba'i kha yi don ston/ rjes 'jug med par gyur na mang po lta ci nga dang khyod ces pa'i don yang ston mi thub/ des na phyi nang gi skad yig rig pa dang / 'od rgyus rig pa/ tshan rig /〈snas srid kyi rnam gzhag 'o/gas gang zhig caslob gnyer byed 'dod kyang ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i brda dag la lnga sa bsam bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ lhag ro na rjes 'jug gi phyu ra ba rnams la shin tu mkhas par byed da spro sa pa gnad kyi don sprod ra sems dgos so//skabs 'dir rjes 'jug gi sbyor ba zhes pa'i go ba ni spyir ming tshig yi ge gsum la go ba dang / khyad par phrad dang rnam dbye'i 'jug pa la go ba yin/de ltar yin pa yang ma bar dngos bstan 'phrad phal che ba rjes 'jug nas btorwa na pa'i rgyu mtshan la thug /tshig gzhan zhig gis bltas da na rjes 'jug gi ༄7ra ba zhes pa ni lung ston pa sum rtags la go'o/ /'di dang bod kyi brda sprod pa dang /bod kyi sgra rig pa rnam gnyis ro na gcig ming gi rnam grangs ro / /rtsa ba las/
412bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥrjes 'jug bcu yi don shes na/ /'bri dang slog dang bshad rnams kyi//mtshams sbyod ra sgra la thogs med cing / /'brel ba smra ba'i mcho ga tu 'gyur//gzhan yang rjes 'jug shes pa yis/ /don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /zhes gsal ba ltar rjes 'jug gi sbyor ba legs par shes pa'i dbo sa pa'am lnga da kyi skad yig brda sprod da dang mthun par shes na dge mtshan gang sku da ches gsal bar gsungs sku da/ der ma zad bla ma'i man ngag ste rgyus sku dod kyi mi yis rgyus 〈snan byed rgyu yang shin tu gal chen yin pa bstan yod/de min skad yig gi gnas tshad ji tsam mtho yang brjod bya don la dbab thub pa'i des pa med/ rtsab las/ rjes 'jug sbyor ba mkhas pa na/ /lung gi don dang sbyor ba dang / /bla ma'i man ngag gsum sbyar nas/ /5wan gyi lnga ga tu dbab par bya//zhes gsal/ de ltar na yang go rim nges can brgyud nas lnga sa bsam byas na sa ror+sha da che ba 5wang zhing / de min sa sna stod mi 'ong ba yang rtsa ba nas gsal/ de nyid las/ bslab la brtson pa'i gang zag gis/ /dang po nga ro rnams la sbyang //sngon 'jug rjes 'jug ming gzhi gsum/ /klog gi ched du bslab pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bzhi yi lha ra ba ni/ /mnyan bsam bstan pa'i dor+shan du sbyar/ /yan lag de dag mthu yis ni/ /'bras bu'i ched du ro don la dbab/ /bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur//de phyir dang bor 'di nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ /bslab pa gang la dad pa yi/ /gzhung nyid bla ma dag las mnyan/ /zhes gsal/ snyu/ na su byung la bslab na rung ngam zhe na/ de yang min te stod ldan kho na la gdams par bya yi/stso rwad mi ldan la gnas skabs gdams par mi bya'o/ /zhes cas ba na gsal/ de

dbyangs gsal sngon rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 423bshad ma thag pa'i ming mtha' snga phyi de dag nyid kyis/ ming mtha' de dag nyid rang gi rtags mtshungs pa'am bsgyu da pa bde bas sgra mthun par gyur pa'i rnam dbye dang po chos dngos te ngo bo tsam brjod pa dang / gnyis pa las su bya ba dang /gsum pa byed pa 'o/'am byed pa tsam dang / bzhi pa sbyin pa'i yul gyis mdo stan nas ched du bya ba dang / lnga pa 'byung khungs dang / drug pa 'brel ba dang / bdun pa gnas gzhi dang / brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra rnams kyang drang ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du gzhan yang rnam dbye'i yan lag tu gyur pa'am ma gyur pa'i tshig phrad/ slar bsdu dang /lhag bcas dang / 'byed sdud dang / bsnan pa dang / bdag po dang / dgag pa dang /sgrub pa dang / tshig rgyan dang / dus te tshe skabs la 'jug pa'i sgra la sogs pa de dag rnams kyang snga ma ming mtha' shugs kyis 'dren par byed pa na 47ra tshul legs par 'byung ba yin lha ste/ /zhes ro///de rnams kyi dper brjod pa ni sum cu pa'i skabs su rgyas par spros zin pa dang gsham du'ang phyogs tsam 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir mi spro zhing / skabs 'dir sgra mthun zhes pa'i ror+sha na rtags mtshungs kho na la phal cher gyis bzhed kyang rnam dbye dang phrad ro gas rtags mtshungs kho nas 'dren par ma nges shing ga tshe lta bor brjod bde ba'i sgra mthun 'dren pa shas che bar snang ba dang / sum cu par/dang spro gnyis la dang po mthun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ /bdun pa nyid la bdun pa ste/ /lhag ma rnams la gya sbyar ba/ /de dag chub sbyar 'brel ba'i sa//zhes sgra mthun tshul gsal bar gsungs pa'ang / da ba sa nga rnams kyi mthar rtags mtshungs 'dren pa 'grig kyang gzhan rnams brjod bde ba tsam la dgongs par snang
424bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbas/ rgyu mtshan 'di rnams dang sbyar na kho bo'i 'grel tshul 'di nyid legs bshad du rtogs par 'gyur ro//27zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don legs par sna gas na da ga smra snad rtags kyi 'jug par phrad dang rnam dbye rnams bshad pa dgos pa 'thad pa dang ldan par yod pa khong du chud nus so//galha tha mar rtags kyi 'jug par phrad dang rnam dbye ston pa'i gzhung ni/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag nang gses rnam par bye//shes pa'i bar rkang pa 8yin/ de snga sum cu par phrad dang rnam dbye rnams kyi ngo bo dper brjod dang bcas pa bshad zin cing / de rjes rtags 'jug nang du phrad dang rnam dbye rnams kyi sgra phru kar rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'ang bshad zin/skabs 'dir slar yang phrad dang rnam dbye rnams 'chad pa ni/ rtsa tshig nang gsal ba bzhin phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug da spro sa pa dang / rnam dbye'i nang gses gang zhig 'jug da spro sa pa shes phyir bstan pa snya ( //dper na/ sangs rgyas lta bu zhig 5wad tshe 'di yi rjes su phrad dang rnam dbye gang zhig 'jug dgos min dang po nyid nas brjod par dka' zhing /'on kyang 'di yi mthar gang zhig sbyar rgyu yin pa de kho nga du chud zin tshe de ma thag phrad dang rnam dbye gang zhig sbyar rgyur dka' ngal med/ 'di nyid gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir rtags 'jug gi gzhung 'dir tshar gsum par phrad dang rnam dbye rnams bstan pa yin/ gal te sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtha' sbyar 'og ma'i ming don de chos kyi 'khor lo bsgord lta bu yin tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi mjug thogs
dbyangs gsal sngo na rjes bcas kyi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 425su gsum pa byed sgra'i kyis sgra dang / lhag bcas kyi te sgra gang rung nges shing /de gnyis las gang zhig 'jug pa de ni rtsom pa po'i kun slong gi rjes su 'gro dgos so//des na sangs rgyas kyis ༄kes kyi 'kho ra 'o/ bzla dord dang / sangs rgyas te phyur+shas kyi 'kho ra 'od bstod ra da gnyis ka srid pa yin/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtha' sbyar 'og ma'i ming don de go 'phang lta bu yin tshe sangs rgyas kyi mjug thogs der drug sgra'i kyi sgra thob par nges te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhes su 'gyur/de bzhin sangs rgyas kyi mtha' sbyar 'og ma'i ming don de phyag 'tshal lo lta bu jiyin tshe sangs rgyas kyi mjug thorwa kas der gnyis pa'i su'am la sgra sbyar da spro sa/dper na sangs rgyas su phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtha' sbyar 'og ma'i ming don der yon tan mnga' lta bu yod tshe sangs rgyas kyi mjug thogs der gnas gzhi'i su sgrar nges te sangs rgyas su yon tan mnga' ru 'gyur ba yin/ de bzhin nang gses 'jug tshul yod do cog bshad kyis mi gangs pas na rtsom pa po'i kun slong rjes 'brel gyis thob tshul shes par byed dgos so//'di thad 'grel chen las/gnyis pa nang gses kyi 'jug tshul 'chad pa la/ dang po mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis las dang po ni/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa//mtha' sbyar 'og ma'i ming don las//28zhes pa ste/ de ltar rnam dbye dang tshig phrad de dag gi nang gses gang dang gang zhig 'jug pa ni gtso bor rnam dbye'am phrad dang bcas pa'i ming tshig de'i mthar
426bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥsbyar rgyu'i ming ngo na lo ga ma gas shes par bya snyu kha/ /zhes spyir bstan pa snyu / /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gzhung don dang 'phros don no/ /dang po la/ rnam dbye'i nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa dang 'phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa gnyis las dang po ni/ spyi 'jug yod dam byed pa yod/ /de bzhin ched byed rten byed dang //gas bya blang bya bsgrub par bya/ /skru tan du res pa gnas pa 'am/ /zhes pas bstan te/de la rnam dbye'i nang gses gang dang gang 'jug pa ni rnam dbye'i sbyar sa'i ming ro gas nas bshad pa dper bsnyu da dang bcas pa gsal bar bshad pa ni bo sla/gnyis pa phrad kyi nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa ni/ gzhan yang tshig 5wan snyung ga ma ltas/ /bsdu rgyu yod dam med pa dang / /gong ma las kyang de bzhin te/ /rnam grangs dag kyang bto da pa las/ /bskyar ba yod dam med pa dang / /'od sgra dang ni 〈 sna sgra dag /ming gi mtha' na 5wad med dang / /rgyan du gyur pa rnams la yang //don la bsnyegs pa yod med dang / /bstan bya lhag ma yod med dang / /tshig don snyu gas dang ma sgyu gas kyis/ /de dag nang gses rnam par dbye/ /zhes ro //'di nas phrad dang rnam dbye'i 'jug tshul dang 'jug yul ma nor ba ma shes su mi rung ba rnams legs par sum rtags kyi gzhung 'di na bstan cing /thams cad ni bshad kyis ga la langs/ rnam da cad da ldan pa rnams kyis rigs 'gres btang nas mkhyen da spro sa pa yin/ dper na snang ṭa'i kha 〈sna bar lho rwab da'o/na gyis shā rna ṭa 'a spro ga stangs dang gang du 'a spro ga dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i lam storwa na byed pa gas 'gog yul mtha' dag ni sngon nas ma nges pas ji ltar lam lta na byed nus/ de ni kha 'od ba rang nyid nas gnas dus la gzhigs te 'a spro ga gdogang da spro sa pa yin pā // //
rab byed dgu pa/rig gnas rgyun 'dzin thabs lam dang de'i dge mtshan/go༅/ /'o snad kyi 5wal rgyun rig gnas kyis 1wal rgyun rig gnas la yid ches pa'i skye lnga rnams la phan bde ste ra ba tsam du ma zad smra la rgyun la de tsam gyis yid ches dang re ba mi byed mkhan rnams la'ang / da gzerwa da 'di la lnga sa bsam byas tshe 'di nyid bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs bla na med pa zhig tu gyur pa'i cha nas 'di nyid rgyun 'dzin byed thub na dge mtshan ldan/ 'di nyid shes sku/na gyi cha nas dge mtshan yod cing / der ma zad bzang spyod kyi ngo bo'i cha nas kyang bzang spyod slob par yang dge mtshan ldan yod/ de bzhin phyi mar yid ches dang rbede skyid 'dod pa rnams la'ang bod kyi srol rgyun 'di nyid dge mtshan ldan par gyur/mtha' mar 'di nyid kyi gal che tshul gang zhig gzhan nas 〈snan re med pa gcig pu de ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa dang thob pa la dge mtshan bla na med pas yin//1yid ches sku rwad med kun la 'di nyid dge mtshan ldan pa yin/༈ lnga da kyi 5wal rgyun rig gnas zhes pa'i skabs 〈snad kyi thun rma snang dang thun min gyi rig gnas sku snangs la 5 4 cor+sha ka /des na rig gnas ni dus dang rgyal khab/mi rigs dang skad yig bcas kyi sa mtshams las 'a〈snangs te nges par du bshad
428bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥdang bsam da spro sa pas na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dge mtshan ldan pa yin/gal te rig gnas gang zhig mgo nas mjug bar lung kho na las rigs par mi ldan pa dang dngos yod gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa zhig yin tshe/ da gzod nga lnga'i sa yid ches byed mkhan 〈sna na las yid ches mi byed mkhan la phan 〈snags med ces smras kyang rung / 'on kyang rang re'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas ni thos bsam sgo ma gsum dang / 'chad sna da sna ma gsum/ dgag bzhag slong gsum/mkhas btsun bzang gsum bcas kyi lag rjes rmad du byung ba 'ba' zhig yin par brten lung dang rigs pa zung ldan du byas te gtan 'bebs byung ba zhe gcig tu za da/ des na rang bzhin gyis 〈snal rgyun gyi rig gnas la yid ches sku da min la ma lta sa par rnam da〈tshad kyi rtsal las 'di nyid dge mtshan ldan pa mngon thub pa yin/gal te rig gnas kyi dmigs yul pā stor sgrub pa zhe gcig yin tshe gcig byas na dus thung nang srol rgyun gyi rig gnas la brten nas nor longs spyod tshong las bzhin mkho sna sgrub byed mi thub pa la brten nas dge mtshan mi ldan pa'ang ma lnga pun srid/gcig tu na bden pa yin pa'i nges pa'ang med de nyo stor yin na phyi dngos ro'i mkho sgrub byed pa'i pā stor yin pas nges pa ga la sku/da/ 〈snad kyi 1/la rgyun gyi rig gnas rnams kyis nang gi nyo4ra chen 'ong chon ra ba bde ba bla na med pa'ang sbyin pa yin/der ma zad nang gi nor de yis skyes bu 'bum phrag mang wa'i bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs bla na med pa'ang byed pa yin//
rig gnas rgyun 'dzin thabs lam dang de'i dge mtshan/ 4292shes yon gyi cha nas kyang 'di nyid dge mtshan ldan pa yin/lha bod skad du bzhugs pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas rnams ni skye ba phyi ma phan chad 〈sna na las tshe 'di'i shes 5snan 'phel rgyas la phan mi 〈snags pa zhig yin na ni da gzod tshe 'di kho nar gtsigs bzung byed mkhan tshan rig pa rnams kyis shin tu gtsigs cher ga la byed srid/ 'on kyang deng gi dus su ni srol rgyun gyi rig gnas 'di nang bzhugs pa'i shes 5wan gyi dge mtshan dang 'dzam gling mi mang zhi bde bag phebs 'ong bar 'di yis phan rlabs che tshul rtogs te thun mong gi rig gnas yod do cog gi rmang gzhi bsam pa'i dpal yon rang re'i rig gzhung 'di 'dra la 'gram chu ldang dgos pa chags yod/ tha na rgya mi yin na yang ma bshad pa tsam ma gtogs don gyi ngo mtshar skye dgos pa chags yod/ snga mo yin na tshan rig pas rang gis mngon sum gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa rnams bden tha min par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod kyang / deng gi char nang chos kyi rigs lam la brten nas med par bshad pa dang med par rtogs pa gnyis kyi dbye mtshams gsal rtogs byung ste da cha tshan rig pa rnams kyis skye ba phyi ma med par bshad pa der ngos 'dzin mi byed cing / skye ba phyi ma yod pa ma shes pa tsam la ngos 'dzin/'di ni srol rgyun gyi rig gnas kyis tshan rig pa'i shes byar shes yon dngos su spel thub pa'i mtshan gzhi yag 'o( zhig yin/ gzhan yang / de snga yin na tshan rig pas brgya cha mang ba'i nyams zhib kyi grub ro na la yid ches byed pa las brgya cha nyung ba'i nyams zhib kyi grub don la de tsam gdeng 'jog mi byed pa yin/ 'on kyang dus phyis ni tshan rig pa brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu yi nyams zhib kyi grub don dang /
430bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥtshan rig pa brgya cha gcig gi nyams zhib kyi grub do/na gnyis mthun gyi mi 'dug na yang phyi ma 'dir gdeng 'jog mi byed pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra lhag gi med/da dung 'ga' zhig gis gcig byed na phyi ma 'di'i grub ro na 'grigs pa dang snga ma tsho'i grub ror+sha na pā stor ba yang mi srid pa ma red ces bsam slo gu yangs po zhe drag chags yod/ spyir btang chos lugs pa'i bsam slo gu dog po yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi phyu sa lugs ni shin tu gu yangs la rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis thad lta snyu da gnyi ga'i thad nas mthar ma lhung ba la brten nas tshan rig dang mnyam du 'a ro gas thub pa byung ba yin/ 'di ni smra rnal rgyun gyi rig gnas kyis shes 〈snan thad dge nya che lugs shig yin par sems//3bzang spyod kyi ngo ba'i cha nas kyang dge mtshan ldan/༈ deng gi dus ni tshan rig gi lam nas dpal 'byor mkho sgrub byed pa'i dus shig yin/ dpal 'a cad ra 'tshol sgrub kyi kho ra yug cig gi nang tshan rig pa dang tshong pa rnams la snod bcud yongs rdzogs rang gi dpal 'byor gyi mthun rkyen du ji ltar bkol thabs kyi bsam slo ma gtogs de la brten nas 'byung 'gyur sa'i go la'i gnas bab ji ltar 'ong bar 'gan 'khyer rgyu lta ci bsam dzā tsam yang mi gtong ba'i dus rabs shig chags 〈snad/'dzam gling gi gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gis mtshon pa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas tshul ji snyed cig nga tsho'i mdun du lhag 5wad na 'jigs pa de dag srung 〈snab byed pa la 〈snal rgyun rig gnas kyis rlabs che'i nus pa 1—na nges yin/
rig khanas rgyun 'dzin thabs lam dang de'i dgo mtshan/ 431rang re'i sku la rgyun rig gnas ni sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lugs la gtugs shing /sangs rgyas kyis gang zhig ci zhig gsungs sku da kyang sems can gyi phan bde 'ba' zhig la da spro ngas te dus bstun bslab bya zhe gcig yin/ ma5war na sangs rgyas kyis gnas skabs phan yang phugs su gnod na dor byar gsungs pa dang /gnas skabs ga lha stod kyang phugs su phan na blang byar gsungs/ gnas skabs dang phyags gnyi gar gnod kyi yod na tha gcig tu dor bya dang / gnas skabs dang phugs gnyi gar phan gyi yod na tha gcig tu blang byar gsungs yod/der brten rang byung khor yug dang de la brten pa'i srog chags rnams la tshad las 'das pa'i bkol spyod byed pa ni rang nyid kho na'i dpal 'byor la gnas skabs phan pa tsam ma gtogs phugs su rang nyid dang bcas pa'i 'dzam gling hril po phung la sbyor ba'i las rigs shig yin par brten dor byar 'os pa yin/gas kyi sne shā dor gtogs pa'i chen 'od ji snyed kyis gnas skabs 'di 'dra la dgongs te kho ra yug dang sems can la phog thug — gzhi'i las rigs la khrims kyi snyu ga nas bkag sgyu ma ji snyed cig byas 5wad/ de dag gi bsam blo'i rgyab rdzongs ni srol rgyun gyi gzhung nang bshad pa'i rten 'brel ltos grub kyi lta bar gzhi bzhag 5wad/ chung sa la mdon na na khyim tshang nang gi bde skyid bcas ga yang sku/la rgyun gyis phan lnga gas byung 5wad/ ro/la rgyun gyi zhag rtsi med mkhan rnams kyi phru gu mang che ba ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs la phan lnga gas byed rgyu lta ci rang gi pha ma rgan 'khog gi bde skyid la yang snang med du bzhag pa'i nyen kha yod/de las thabs rdugs pa 'ga' zhig gis ni pha ma'i bka' drin dran rgyu'i tshab la pha mas sdug po btang rabs shod mkhan yang yong gi yod/ 'di 'dra mi srid pa

zhu dag byed stangs stor bshad pa/ 455bstan 'dzin zhes pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis che ma spro (7)bkur s+t+ri zhu yul mtha' dag la 'bri ba'i srol zhig 'dug pa 'di ni bod mi'i spyi srol dang mi mthun par snyam/ che mgo gang du 'bri yul ni phal cher yul gcig tu nges pa min yang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len du ji ltar yod pa de ltar 'bri dgos par sems/dper na/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog yin/ che mgo med na bkur sti mi zhu ba'i spro don min pa de gsal por mkhyen dgos/ dper na/ stod na pa shākya thub pa lta bu gas lhag pa'i bkur s+t+ri zhu yul gzhan zhig med kyang sto snan pa la che mgo mi 'bri ba ni phyag len du med pas yin/ 7spro/nga sa ma〈keg la che ma〈sna phyag ba'i rgyu mtshan zhi phyag len du 5snad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pā sto//yang 'ga' zhig gis ming rkyang tshang mar da lta ba 'bri dgos par sems te dril bsgrags dang khyab bsgrags kyi 〈snad du dril spro ga dang khyab sgrodaka ces bris pa de ltar snang / tha snyad 'di rigs la cung zad dpyad na/ gnyan chen tha ngu lha'i gsar shog tu rang re tshang mas rgyun du bed spyod byed bzhin pas ma tshad de snga 11da gzhung las khungs gcig gi ming du yang gyur pa'i dril bsgrags zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i dag char 'gyur ba zhig btang ste dril 11ga ces bto4da 'dug/de las 'a'o(sa te khyab bsgrags zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i dag char 'gyur ba zhig btang ste khyab sgrog ces bkod 'dug /dpe mtshon du gsar shog de'i 'don thengs bcu dgu pa'i 〈snag 1 r+shas gnyis par bka' 〈snab dril spro ga ces dang / 〈snag skyongs gsum par mgrin pa na rag bar khyab spro ga byed pa'i mjug 'bras/ de bzhin 〈snag lnga sa bzhi par rang btsan khyab sgrog ces bkod 'dug/
456bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥspyir btang rang re'i lnga da yig nang dag cha mi mthun pa mi nyung ba zhig 5wad pa de dag la mkhas pa so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yod pa spros med thog sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rab gang rung zhig la gzhi ba༄wal ba ma ga lta snags ltarwa ga bzo'i dbang gis bris pa da to na/ lhag par tha snyad gsar pa ba rā sna ba'am yang na sngar yod tha snyad la 'gyur ba zhig ga ro slong bar 'dod na rtags 'jug nas gsungs pa'i sgra mthun gyi slor dang yul sku la goms gshis dang bed spyod kyi dbang gis yongs grags su gyur pa'i tha snyad rnams la dmigs bsal gyi thugs snang gnang da spro sa pa las snang med du 'jog mi rung / spyir na 'og tshod cig byas pa yin na gnyan chen thang lha'i gsar phyarwa ka tu dril lha ga dang khyab sgrorwa ka ces bto da pa'i skabs su nyada to/ngas pa bzhes sa ni khyab bsgrags dang dril bsgrags ni ming rkyang yin pa dang /ming rkyang yin na da lta ba'i dag cha 'bri da〈snas par bsam pa yin par lha gas/yin na'ang rang nyid kyis kha khu7na ga༄wad ga la nus te mi yi rgyud dond mi yis longs dka' ba'i phyir//gal te rang nyid kyi 'ol chond de bden pa yin pa'i dbang du btang na ni/khyad rnams kyis khyab spro ga dang dril sgrid ga bed phrung da byas pa de mi 'thad ces brjod 'dod yod/ gang yin zer na/ dus gsum ci rigs dang / dus gsum gang rung ma yin pa/ de bzhin skul tshig dang bcas pa las grub pa'i ming rkyang du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dpe mtshon lta bur/ slob dpon lta bu da lta ba dang /bslab bya lta bu ma 'ongs pa dang / dgra bcom pa lta bu 'das pa dang / thongs mchan lta bu skul tshig dang / skyabs 'gro lta bu dus gsum gang rung ma yin pa las grub pa'i ming rkyang lgi dper brjod yin//
zhu dag byed stangs skor bshad pa/ 457sku na deng lho tags bsgrigs la 6wags sgrig dang / sgrigs gzhi la sgrig gzhi lta bu bris pa mang po 'dug na/ de dag la khyed kyis ci zer rgyu yin zhes gal te dri ba 'dorwa na pa byung na/ de la 'di ltar smra ste/ dril bsgrags la dril spro ga ces pa rtags 'jug nas gsungs pa'i sgra mthun gyi legs bshad dang 'gal bas 'thad pa ma yin la/ lhu tags bsgrigs la 〈snags sgrig ces pa de rtags 'jug gi sgra mthun gyi legs bshad dang mi 'gal bas 'thad dong/ /de bzhin khyab bsgrags la khyab 〈snag ces pa de rtags 'jug gi sgra mthun gyi legs bshad dang 'gal ba yin pas 'thad pa ma yin la/ de las 〈snag ste sgrigs gzhi la sgrig gzhi zhes bris pa de rtags 'jug gi sgra mthun gyi legs bshad dang mi 'gal bas 'thad par khas 'ches 〈sna//dril bsgrags dang dril sgrog gnyis gar rtags mtshungs med par mnyam na'ang /dang po der brjod bde yod pa dang / phyi ma der brjod bde med pa des dang po der sgra mthun yod pa dang / phyi ma de ra sgra mthun med par bstan yod/'on kyang phyogs bsgrigs dang phyogs sgrig gnyis gar rtags mtshungs med pa mnyam na'ang gnyis gar brjod bde yod pas dang po de 'thad pa dang phyi ma de mi 'thad ces rang nyid smra bar mi 'dod/ 'on kyang phyi ma de yi ge nyung ba dang /da lta ba gsal byed yin pa'i phyir na/ phyi ma 'thad par sems so/ /spyir na da lta ba gal mi che yang gal te ba〈snad bde 5 rwa da pa dus mi 'dra ba gnyis 5snad tshe da lta ba 'thad par bshad pa brda 〈snad pa'i lugs rod/ /dril bsgrags dang dril 〈snag gnyis la sgra mthun yod med kyi khyad par gtso bo ni 'phul dang yang 'jug yod med de la thug pa ma yin/ de gnyis su brjod bde yod min ni dbyangs kyis brgyan ma brgyan la thug pa yin//
458bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥder brten ming rkyang la da lta ba'i dag cha 'bri ba'i rtsol ba de mi 'thad pa min na'ang / gal te der dbyangs kyi 'gyur ba 'gro yi 'dug na shin tu gzab dgos pa yin/ khyad rang gis ci bshad kyang ming rkyang la da lta ba 'bri ba de nga rang gi lugs yin zhes lugs ngan mi 'dor na ni gong du 'khod pa'i bslab bya la slob byed dang /dgra ba༄wam pa la dgra 'joms pa/ snyu ngas mchan la ga lta slong mchan/ skyabs 'phra la lha ba 'a lha zhes 'gyur ba zhig btang ste 'bri da spro sa par thal/ gang lags she na/dril bsgrags la dril spro ga dang/ khyab bsgrags la khyab 〈snag ces bris zin pa dang /gsal bsgrags la gsal 〈snag dang ched bsgrags la ched 〈snag ces 'bri bar 'gyur gā rnams dang 'brel chags par sku/nga bar phan nges/ yang rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig gsal bshad gnang rgyu sku da na ni dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsu bar 1zug/ /gzhan yang be ri dge bshes kyis/blo bzang gis sta res shing gcod lta bu brjod pa'i tshe/ blo bzang gi rtsol ba'i skyongs nas phar 'gul lha khad byed pa'i dus kyi khyad par la bsams nas ba〈snad na/ blo sna bzang gis shing ga〈snad zin/ ga〈snad bzhin pa/gcod rgyu red/ ces 'bri dgos/ gcad bya'i shing gi ngos nas tshur 'pho 'gyur 'a〈sna ba'i dus kyi khyad par la bsams nas ba〈snad na/slo bzang gis shing gcad zin/ gcad bzhin pa/ gcad rgyu red ces 'bri dgos/ blo bzang gis shing ga〈snad pa'i tshe blo bzang gis sta re phar 'degs 'a〈snag gi sna la ba dang / shing gi skyongs nas tshur 'a'o 'gyur 'a〈sna ba'i khyad par gang la yang ma bsams par shing ga pur+sha da pa'i dus kyi khyad par tsam la bsam nas brjod na zlo bzang zhis shing bcad zin/
zhu dag byed stangs stor bshad pa/ 459ga ther+sha da bzhin pa/ gcad 'gyur/ zhes 'bri da to sa pa rnams zhib tu shes na gsung rab kyi brda chad mang spro zhig la 'jug pa sla zhing sngar ma myong ba'i bro ba gsar pa zhig myong rgyu yod par sems so nazhes gsungs pa 'di ni brda spro da pa'i nang gting tshugs pa'i dus gsum gyi dag cha de tshor yang the tshom skye gzhir gyur pa'i 'grel brjod cig tu 'gro nyen che/'di yang dpyad par bya ba'i gnad gcig tu mthong //'di dang phyogs mtshungs shi gi a lags dor zhis kyang mdzad 'dug na ji 'gab zhib 'jug mdzad 'tshal/ a lags dor zhis/ 'od srung lta bu la da lta ba'i cha nas cos da srung dang / ma ldangs pa'i cha nas snyung da bsrung / 'das pa'i cha nas cas da bsrungs dang / skul tshig gi cha nas cod da srungs zhes bris pa rnams la go ba rgya chen spro zhig yod slor bris gnang 'dug /dngos don bshad na ca rnams la go ba dmigs bsal gang yang med cing / 'di dag nyan thos chen po 'od srung gi mtshan tsam du zad/ 'di nyid ming yin pa'i skabs su 'di la yul yul can dang 'das ma 'ongs kyi bsam slo gtong ba ni dus gron 'ba' zhig tu zad/sngar dag cha rnams gting tshugs pa ma chags pa'i 〈snan 〈snal tu dus gsum ci rigs las snyu da srung gi dag char bris sku da kyang / phyis su brda spro da kyi nyams zhib pa mang po'i lag rjes la brten nas 'od srung la da lta ba'i dag cha 'bri ba de snyodangs khyab chags sku dod//des na 'od srung gi srung la dus gsum ci rigs bris na 'thad par sems pa ni shin tu mi 'thad pa'i gtam du zad/ 'on kyang srung byed la da lta ba dang /bsrung bya la ma 'ongs pa dang / kha sang kho snang gis bsrungs la 'das pa dang /
460bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥsang nyin spu da kyis srungs shig la skul tshig lnga ba pa zhi su la yang the 49ma za da spro rwa so pa zhig gtan nas min/ lar nas bya byed gas gsum gyi lnga byos 'dzin ni nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nang du bkol ba'i bya byed las gsum dang gsung rab gting zab nas byung ba'i bya byed las gsum gyi ngos 'dzin dbar khyad par tig 'bru tsam yang med/ 'on kyang mtshan gzhi 'god pa'i skabs re zhig rtogs sla la re zhig rtogs dka' bar gyur pa zhi bya byed las gsum gyi ngos 'dzin rtogs dka' sla'i steng nas min la/ de ni brjod bya'i nang don rtogs dka' sla'i cha nas khyad par du zhugs pa ni nges par du yod//nya ming rkyang la dus gsum ci rigs dang yang na dus gsum gang rung min par 'bri dgos pa bshad pa 'dir bstan bcos kyi rgyab rten yang yod de/ ji skad du/der ma zad bod skad kyis ming 'dogs tshul du ma yod de/ byed tshig gi 〈sna nas brjod tshul/ las sam bya yul gyi sgo nas bsnyu da tshul/bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu'i lha nas brjod tshul/ skul tshig gis brjod tshul/ bya byed sogs gang du'ang mi gtogs pa'i brjod tshul ro gas 5wad pa las/ byed tshig gis ba〈snad pa'i ming ni sgrub thabs zhes pa'i sgrub dang / phyur+shas srung zhes pa'i srung so rwags lta bu dang /bya tshig gis btags pa'i ming ni byin brlab ces pa'i brlab dang /bstan bcu byos zhes pa'i bstan/ bslab gsum zhes pa'i bslab pa la 〈snags pa lta bu yin/ bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu'am 'das tshig gis ming btags pa ni / sdong spro bkod pa'i mdo zhes pa'i bkod pa dang /dgra bcad ma pa zhes pa'i bca ma pa lta bu yin/ skul tshig gis ming
zhu dag byed stangs skor bshad pa/ 461btags pa ni yid srubs zhes pa'i srubs dang mgul chings zhes pa'i chings/ lho rwas zla/na zhes pa'i sdu snas pa rnams yin/ bya byed do/gas gang du yang mi gtorwa gas pa'i ming ni byin rlabs zhes pa'i rlabs dang /khang brtsegs zhes pa'i brtsegs dang / dul ba zhes pa'i dul ba dang /tshong pa zhes pa'i tshong lta bu rnams yin//3zhes gsungs 〈sna/ /gzhan yang skabs ro na la blta da spro sa pa ni shin tu gal che ste / dper na/ bstan 'gyur dang brten 'gyur gnyis nas gang zhig 'thad pa de yin nam zhe na/ gnyis ka 'thad pa yin/ lha shun kyang gdam nga min/bstan 'gyur 'bri sar brten 'gyur 'bri mi rung / de bzhin brten 'gyur 'bri sar yang bstan 'gyur 'bri mi rung / ston pa shākya thub pa'i dgongs 'grel bstan ba༄was bod skad du bsgyur ba rnams la bstan 'gyur dang / bon gyi gzhud gang zhig yarwa na storwa na gshen rab kyi gsung rab la brten pa'am wa snad skad du bsgyur ba rnams la brten 'gyur zhes 'bri da〈stos pa yin/ de bzhin gnas brtan dang gnas rten/ rgyal gces dang rgyas bcad/ gna' 'brel dang mna' 'brel/bya bral dang bya brel/ bong dang bongs/ phas rgol dang phar sgol/ brtse dang rtse/'jig dang 'jigs/ mngon brjod dang mngon spyod/ bshad sgrub dang dngos grub/sa bcad dang sa dpyad/ lung rigs dang shes rig /mchod brjod dang chos spyod/mchod pa dang chos pa/ sum cu dang gsum bcu/ rnam dpyod dang rnam gcod/skad gdangs dang skas gdang la ro/gas pa rnams tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na'ang ro na la khyad par shin tu che bas gzab da〈snas 〈sna//
462bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥde yang rgyal gces dang rgyas bcad la dpyad pa thung ngu zhig byas pa yin na rgyal gces zhes pa ni rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la gces zhen che zhing / de yi don du dgos gal byung bstun rang gi lus srog longs spyod dang bcas pa yang slos gtong bya rgyur the tshom spru tsam mi byed pa'i bsam slo bzang po zhig la zer/de 'dra gang la ldan pa'i skyes bu de la rgyal gces pa zer zhing / skyes bu de la rgyal khab kyi gzhung mang yongs nas bstod bkur bsngags par 'os pa yin/ dper na rgyal gces pa dpa' 'ong thub bstan da lngangs grub dang / dpa' 'ong bkra bhe+e lags la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang rgyas bcad ces pa ni gzhung ngam sgrig 'dzugs gung yang rung ba zhig nas yongs khyab gtan 'bebs byas te tshang mas rtsa 'dzin bya rgyu'i khrims kyi phyag rgyas bcings pa'am bcad pa'i bkas bcad lta bu zhig la zer/deng dus mang spro zhig nas rang re'i deb ljang khya de la rgyal gces ma dngul dang /skabs re rang btsan lag deb kyang zer ba yin/ snyu stun kyang lag deb ljang khu'i dngul 'bul byed pa ni dang 〈snag 1—da mi mang po zhig gis rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten du phul ba yin yang rim gyis de nyid rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la gces min gyi so mtshams shig min par/bod gzhung nas khrims su bcas pa'i rgyas bcad kyi bsdu dngul zhig tu gyur yod/des na rang gi bsam ngor bod kyi yul mi tshang mas nges par du 'bul dgos pa'i bsdu dngul de dag la rgyas bcad kyi bsdu dngul zer dgos/ de ni bod mi yin no cog gis dbul rgyu'i bsdu dngul de yin na'ang 'dra/ yang na de las gzhan pa'i brgya cha'i bsdu dngul de yin na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar gnyis ka rgyas bcad yin pa las rgyal gces bsdu dngul min/ brgya cha de rgyas bcad yin par brten bod mi

zhu dag byed stangs skor bshad pa/ 491gong du zhus pa bzhin gsung rab deb gzugs su dpar skrun gnang skabs rgya rim pa bdun gyi nang nas mtha' mi 'a〈snal ba sne thig gi rgya bto/la ba'i deb gzugs dpar skrun zhus pa dpe mtshang na zhu rgyu tsam ma 4 gas sku ngas grags dpar skrun gyi lag len du dgos mkho yod stor de snga re zung nas lam ston dpe mtshon dang 'grel bshad zhus pa byung 'dug kyang khong la nyan 'jog gnang med pa'i dngos yod lo rgyus byung yod/ gsung rab dpar skrun zhu skabs rgya rim pa bdun gyis bcings dgos pa de la gong rim nas bka' 'khrol zhu dgos rtsa ba nas med kyang deng shes mkhan nyung ba dang / mi shes mkhan donas shes mkhan re zung gi zhal la nyan rgyu dka' tshegs can dang khrag ma sto na sla ba〈snas su song ba'i nyer len la brten nas tshang mas lnga sa len sku da pa'i shes 5wan gyi bsti gnas shig nas dpar du skrun skabs rgya rim pa bdun bto la dbo sa pa'i bto da khyab lam stodon gyi tshul du gnang thub na dge mtshan ci che co slong bar gdor+shan mi za/de min deb re zung steng de snga yang bkol yod la 'byung 'gyur yang tshul bzhin bkol rgyur yid ches yod/ 'on kyang 'di rigs re zung gis bkol bas mi 〈snag cing tshang mas tshul bzhin ba lha rnal da〈stos pa gal chen yin pa sems rong /'jar man du bzhugs pa'i rdzong rtse byams pa thub bstan lags nas lo rgyus kyi dpe deb gang zhig rang sga phyag bris su 5wad pa de dag tu mtha' mi 'dorwa spru ba sne thig gi rgya de tshul bzhin bkol yod/ byang a ri nas dpe deb nor bu'i bang mdzod ces pa der yang mtha' mi 'phyur+sha la ba sne thig gi rgya tshul bzhin 5wad/ de bzhin rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug go 'jo rgan tshe dbang rnam rgyal mchog gi zla zer dang /khong gis zhus dag bgyis pa'i zla ba'i 'od zer rnam gnyis su sne thig gi rgya tsam

556bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥlta sgrub ched 'jug /mo yig 'a ni 'chad pa po/ /'chad par byed dang 'chad par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dngos po bdag dngos dang / /'gro ba po dang 'gro bar byed//ces ro/gas bdag ro sten phal pa dang / /'khyil 'o( zhes ro/gas da lta ba/ /'khyil bar 'gyur ro/gas ma 'ongs 'jug /shin tu shā sna yi ma yig ni/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum mnyam par 'jug /'on kyang byed po gzhan dngos dang / /'brel ba'i 'das la 'a'i sngon 'jug /med par nges shing ga da nyung / /da lta ba la ba'i sngon 'jug/nyung zhing ma spro can da lta bar/ /bas 'phul med par nges pa tsam/ /gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher/ /byed pa po ni da lta dang / /bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas/ /'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug 5wad/ /da lta ba la gnyis ka med//ma 'o jis 'phul yod yang 'jug med/ /skul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod//skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la/ /sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa'ang sku/da//rjes 'asa ba phye ba rjes 'jug yi ge bcu 〈sna la/ /'o/ sna ma ning gsum du dbye//pho la skyes bu rab 'bring gsum/ /13mo la mo dang shin rgya mo/ /mning 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /mtshan med dag dang gsum du 'dod/ /de yang byed pa bzhi byed de/ /14gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar gug byed ci phyir byed//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu 'o/ yi/ /ga da ba sa bzhi rnams 'od/ /nga ma 'a gsum sna/ yin cing / /na ra la gsum ma ning ste/ /ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug /gang la yi ge thams cad la/ gang gis bcu 'ong do dag gis//ji ra 'a pa 15ji ltar rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /ji ltar 'jug tshul gnyis yin te/ sgra yi 'jug tshul do rnan gyi tshul/ /sgyur gsum 〈sna gnyis ma ning
lhan thabs/ 557gsum/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jug /16drag pa gsum nyid nang phrad dam//gal te zhan pa nang phrad na/ /de la'ang nang gi cha shas kyis/ /de yang drag zhan gnyis su dbye/ /17ma ning gsum du gang gtorwa nas pa/ /drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang phrad gyur na//18de ni gnyis ka can du 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang ma phrad na/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /des na 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang / /19mtshan med dag dang gsum du 'dod/ /de ni sgra yi 'jug tshul lo// dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni//pho yig ga yig yang 'jug can/ /skyes bu rab dang pho yig ba/ /yang 'jug can ni skyes bu 'bring / /ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang / /da sa'i mtha' can tha ma ste//drag pa pho la'ang nang gses kyis/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du dbye/ /de bzhin zhan pa mo la yang / /nang gses drag zhan gnyis dbye ste/ /nga ma yang 'jug can mo dang / /nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang / /'a mtha' can rnams shin tu shā///bar ma ma ning na ra la/ /yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /ming gzhi pho yig mthar yod dang / /ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na/ /drag dang 'phrad pas drag par 'gyur/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni//yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /zhan dang 'phrad pas zhan par 'gyur/ /de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning yin/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na/ /drag zhan gnyis ga'i cha ldan phyir/ /mtshan gnyis ma zhing zhes su grags/ /ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na//drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas/ /mtshan med ma ning zhes su 'dod//
558bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥsa ma ngas nga bsnyung ba gyi 'a la 〈snan ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba dang / /20phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'o/ /snga ma skru don 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar//phyi ma dag gi 'dren tshul ni/ /'o sna yis 〉wa yi ming mtha' drang / /21sna yis sna yi ming mtha' drang / /ma ning gis ni ma ning lnga / /ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis ni//de nyid rang gi sgra mthun pa'i/ /22chos dngos las dang byed pa dang / /sbyin dang 'byung khungs 'brel ba dang / /gnas dang bod pa'i sgra yang drang ka /gzhan yang slar bsdu lhag bcas dang / /23'byed sdud brnan dang bdag po dang //dgag sgrub rgyan dang dus la'ang 'jug /de dag snga shugs 'dren pas 'byung / /de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /24mtha' sbyar lo ga ma'i ming ro na las/ /spyir 'jug yod dam byed pa yod/ /de bzhin ched byed rten byed dang ka /las bya blang bya bsgrub par bya/ /25〈snan du 'os pa gnas pa'am/ /gzhan yang tshig ro ston 'o ka ma las//bsdu rgyu 5wad dam med pa dang / /lha nga ma las kyang de bzhin te/ /26rnam grangs dag kyang bdo da pa las/ /bskyar bsku/da dam med pa dang / /〉wa sgra dang ni 〈sna sgra dag/ming gi mtha' na yod med dang / /27rgyan du gyur pa rnams la lang ka /don la bsnyegs pa sku/da med dang / /bstan bya lhag ma 5wad med dang / /tshig ro na 〈snags dang ma sgyu gas kyis/ /28de dag nang gses rnam par dbye/ /gnyis pa ro sten la gnyis sku da pa'i/ /snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /rjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa yi//ming des bdag gzhan ro gas gang storwa na/ /phal cher ming de'i sngo don 'jug gi/nus par sbyar nas rtogs par bya/ /phyi ma ji ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /rjes 'jug pho yis 'o/ yig gi /ming mtha' gzhan drangs de bzhin du/ /sna sna yis ro/ yi ming mtha'
lhan thabs/ 559dang / /ma ning gis ni ma ning drangs/ /de rnams rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul te//bsgyu da bde 'dren pa'ang shin tu mang / /gzhan yang ming mtha' de nyid kyis//rtags mtshungs pa 'am sgra mthun pa'i/ /rnam dbye brgyad dang slar bsdu sogs//snga ma'i shugs dang mthun par 'dren/ /de dag nang gses gang 'jug ni/ /rnam dbye'am 'phrad ces ming tshig de'i/ /mtha' sbyar ming don las shes bya//de yang chos rnams ngo bo tsam/ brjod pa rnam dbye dang po ste/ /dper na bum pa ka ba bzhin/ /gsal byed 'o rwad kyi skad la nyung / /las dang bya yul don gcig ste//de lta'i bya ba'i yul zhig la/ /bya ba byed par storwa na pa la/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / /gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang / /bzhi pa dgos ched gsum 'dra yang //bya ba byas pa'i bya ba'i yul/ /de 'am de dang 'brel ba la/ /phan thogs med na gnyis pa ste/ /dper na shar du 'gro lta bu/ /phan thogs yod na bzhi pa ste/ /dper na slong la sbyin lta bu/ /phan thogs med kyang bya yul dang / 9/bya ba ngo bo gcig yin na/ /gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid de/ /dper na lha ru gsal lta bu//gang zhig gang la brten pa 'am/ /gnas dang sku da pa'i lnga ston tsam las/ /bya ba gtan nas mi byed na/ /rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ste/ /dper na steng du mi sku da ltar/ /tshe skabs gnyis dang don 'dra na/ /bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs te//dper na mchu zla shar ba na/ /chod 'phrul dus chen tshugs lta bu/ /rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / /de nyid tshe skabs gsal byed sgra/ /su ra ru du na la tu/ /yin zhing phal cher la sgra dang / /mthun pas la don rnam dbye'ang zer/ /'on kyang na la de nyid la/ /mi 'jug smra ba'i sgo las gsungs/ /rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des//nye rgyang gang du sbyar ba zhig /byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste/ /dper na bdag gis
560bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥbshad lta bu/ /bya ba gtan nas mi byed par/ /snga phyi 'brel byed tsam stongu na na/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ /dper na bdag gi mig lta bu/ /rnam dbye gsum drug gsal byed sgra /sa mtha' 5wad dang med pa yi/ /gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga yin//gang zhig gang las byung ba 'am/ /bye dang lhung ba'i don ldan na/ /rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs te/ /dper na zhal las thorwa pu lta bu/ /gsal byed sgra ni nas las te//dgar dang sdud pa'ang lnga par gtogs/ /gzhan yang tshig don gong 'og tu//bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra /dang dang kyang yang 'ang sogs sbyor/ /rnam grangs du mas don bskyar na/ /'byed sdud sgra 'jug dgag pa dang / /bdag don yod na thog nya ru/ /pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rigs 'jug /rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad kyang / /de don la bsnyegs sa sku/da na rje/ra/ /de bzhin bstan bya lhag sku/da na//lhag bcas sgra sbyor tshig don ni/ /rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams sbyor//ci phyir 'ja pa ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ /yi ge'i kho ngas nas ming dbyung ste/ /ming gi kho ngas nas tshig phyung nas//29tshig gis don rnams ston par byed//skyob ྅) 92lnga( rnga/ ྅) 'bu rnga/ che(rna /9 1 'bu 'gyu rnga/ zla zung shub skyob the) med pa na/ /pho yig brjod pa med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang //30'jug par bcas pa med par ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus//ming tshig gsal bar med na ni/ /don rnams brjod par mi 'gyur ro/ /mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na/ /'od yig gsal byed brjod mi nus/ /de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde/ /pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang / /rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i/ /ming dang don gyi khyad par rnams//
lhan thabs/ 561ston pa'i tshig dang don ldan pa'i/ /ngag gi brjod pa yod min te/ /yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing / /ming gi phyo/ngas nas tshig phyungs nas/ /tshig gis lnga na rnams lta dzin pas dran/ /ming tshig bsdu tshud pa med na ni/ /mthun shā dong mthun shā1nga ma yin pa'i/ /shes bya ston pa'ang med par 'gyur//nga so smra rna cad sa sa ba pa 31de ltar gyur na 'jig rten du//don mtshon brjod pa kun kyang med/ /rig byed smra ba'ang yod mi 'gyur// nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi/ /32bslab pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur//ba bcu r+shas 'a 'i sa pa ba pa ji ltar 'jig rten sems can dag/phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /grub mtha' gzhan yang yod na yang //na zharang nyid kyis ni mi shes bzhin/ /de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/smra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang / /rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas/ /34don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /de phyir smra ba'i dbang phyug gi /rjes smras 'di kun rtogs gyur cig/de phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams kyi/ /rjes su 'brangs nas gsungs pa 'di//skye bo kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na yang / /don la khyad par shin tu che/ /de phyir brda dag la brten nas/ /ma pā stor do sten rnams 'do la ba gces//don la mi sna ngas sgyu dongs pa yang / /lugs 'dir mkhas min gyis byed de//sgra shes ro na la mi sna ngas zhes/ /mkhas pa'i gsung la 5wangs su grags/ /'di la ma sbyangs rmongs tshod kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grwar 'jug pa/ /wa skyes seng lpags sdu chen pa bzhin/ /nam zhig rjes ngan gsal bar 'gyur/ /de phyir slo gsal lnga na gnyer rnams/ /rtags 'jug dka' gnad gzugs brnyan kun//gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'dir/ /la 'ur gzigs mor spyon dang kye/ /'di
562bod kyi brda sprod nag 9kaḥla lha stongs pa'i con gas mchis na/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags//cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dges/ /kun gyis 'di don sna stegs par shog/byukar ṇa'i rtsa ba brgyad pa gas kun tu bzang spro'i byukar ṇa gnyis pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// //ces rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying wa'i don mdo tsam brjod pa dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni rang gi slob bu rje drung sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rdo dang ) na grub phun tshon gas gnyis nas dbo sa tshul ltar mkhas mchor+sha ga si tu paṇa chen dang thams cad mkhyen pa dharma bha dra dpal bzang ro'i bzhed pa dang mthun par dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'o//nya(nag 9kaḥ rtsom pa pos sum rtags rtsab dang legs bshad rdzon dbang dang dka' gnad gsal ba'i me 'o/nga rnam gnyis mtshams sbyor byas te bto/da pa'o )
dpar skrun sgyu na tshiglta rnam spro la zhi ba'i rgya mdon ra 1ri gcig tu/ /ga snya la ba'i mtha' yas chor+shas tshul dal 'bab klung / /tshig gi gzegs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma 5wangs 'khrud legs bshad bdud rtsi 'di/ /dpar du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung po'i mthus/ /yang dag chos kyi sgo mo stong phrag brgya/ /gdangs te rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog/ces pa 'di yang deng dus yid srubs kyis rgyud brlams pa'i kla klo'i sdig spyod mi bzad pas gangs rdzongs chos ldan gyi zhing du thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo'i snang ba ltar 'bar ba de ni ming gi lhag ma tsam du nyam nyes par byas/ lhu tags dang lhu khanas na rdul phran gyi mchos na cha ro gas gdug pa'i ga pā stod 'tshe gya gyu'i sbyod ra ba ni nyin re bzhin du dar ba sogs sgo kun nas lnga bdo'i rgud tshogs mtsho ltar brdol ba 'di dag lhag med du zhi zhing /byang phyogs lnga da kha ba can du bstan pa'i me ro slar yang sngar bzhin ga ro sa te rgya gar 'phags pa'i ljongs 'dir yang thub pa'i bzhed dgongs dri ma med pa dar rgyas su 'phel slad dang / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam storwa na rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i ring lugs sgo kun nas rgyas pa sogs 'phral yun legs tshogs du ma'i ched du dmigs/ sbag sa nang bstan shes rig 'dzin lha nga slo rwa ba gnyer khang du nang bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab par du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i slon tshig tu/ shākya'i dge sbyong chos smra ba ngag dbang slo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor+shas sbyar bsku // //
cad kyi na 7da nas sna ka 'a ri la cad rgyu skad rna lag bcangs 'a cad kyang mngos ri gla na par ma 'di cad ban cad rab gnyer ba khon ra dmigs pa zhen rtan na min cing/'di ni cad skad ge pag nga tshus pa'i gi tshad: mngondu byed pa'i ba da nas cad ca mnas nang du bdugs pa'i rig ||khye / sgyu/sro /khri ༷ 3399/ hūm̐ zu sprul re ba'ang cad can /'di lda phudang po༄dang tams ba khu 7)5 rkur mkho bo'i cad gyi ban sprod kyi pyad dpa gcan so/
